2c66acb14d3cacba872e.description:
Learning Business Process as a Service (LBPaaS) helps enterprises operate and continuously improve learning programs through managed services, technology, and global delivery capabilities. As a Manager, Learning Operations Managed Services , you will lead the delivery and ongoing improvement of managed learning operations for large enterprise clients. You will translate operating requirements into scalable service processes across learning administration, content development, reporting, vendor management, and service performance management. You will partner with client leaders, global delivery teams, and technology providers to improve learner experiences, service quality, and business outcomes.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 11/15/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Learning Manager on the Business Process as a Service team, you will be responsible for:  

* Lead managed learning operations engagements from transition through steady-state delivery, including learning administration, content development, reporting, vendor management, and service performance management
* Manage delivery plans, service-level agreements, operational metrics, risks, issues, and corrective actions across assigned client workstreams
* Direct global delivery teams and coordinate work across Deloitte teams, client stakeholders, and technology and delivery partners
* Identify and implement process improvements using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and learning technologies to improve efficiency, quality, and learner outcomes
* Lead client governance activities, including status reporting, performance reviews, decision tracking, and delivery communications

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
  
Our Insights, Innovation & Operate offering within Deloitte Human Capital helps organizations design, run, and continuously improve people operations. We combine functional expertise in human resources and learning with technology capabilities and managed-services delivery to help clients achieve workforce effectiveness and measurable business value.  
  
The Learning Business Process as a Service team delivers end-to-end managed learning operations across enterprise learning and development, customer education, and partner enablement. Using Deloitte's global delivery footprint and an ecosystem of technology and delivery partners, we help clients improve learner impact and business outcomes.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree
* 6+ years of experience delivering learning operations, managed services, or business process outsourcing services for external clients, including 3+ years of experience in a consulting or client-service environment
* 3+ years of experience leading enterprise learning operations that included at least two of the following: learning administration, content development, helpdesk support, vendor management, or service-performance reporting
* 1+ years of experience leading a managed-services delivery workstream that included operational reporting, service performance management, or vendor management
* 1+ years of experience applying AI or automation to learning operations, including content authoring, workflow automation, or analytics
* Ability to travel 0-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

  
Preferred:  

* Master's degree or Master of Business Administration (MBA)
* 1+ years of experience managing a global delivery model that included offshore or nearshore teams
* 1+ years of experience using learning management system (LMS) or human capital management (HCM) platforms
* 1+ years of experience managing customer education, partner enablement, certification, or credentialing programs
* 1+ years of experience measuring managed-services performance against service-level agreements

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. **Work you'll do**  
  
As a Wealth Management and Trust Operations - Investment Management Senior Consultant on the Enterprise Operations & Risk team, you will be responsible for...  

* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize business, operational, regulatory, and technology risks across wealth management and trust operations; document risk mitigation strategies.
* Support operational governance and execution, including service management routines, escalation paths, control ownership, issue management, and management reporting, across internal teams and third parties.
* Assess the effects of automation and artificial intelligence/machine learning on operational controls, data quality, and process resilience.
* Develop operating model assessments, current-state and future-state process maps, control inventories, key risk indicators, service-level agreements, operating-level agreements, vendor oversight artifacts, and procedure documentation.
* Conduct research and engage industry participants on operating model trends, outsourcing and insourcing considerations, vendor capabilities, and market practices affecting operations.

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our Enterprise Operations & Risk offering enables clients to achieve profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing "heart of the business" operations. We leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility and remediation. Our professionals address client needs which span the organization and impact strategy, operations, performance and reputation.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of experience in financial services or consulting with exposure to investment management operations, such as asset managers, wealth managers, hedge funds, private equity, fund administrators, custodians, prime brokers, or related service providers.
* Demonstrated knowledge within asset management, wealth management, hedge funds, private equity, and/or operational risk and controls in investment management.
* Understanding of wealth management and trust operations such as transaction processing, account onboarding, digital asset administration, financial advisor support, recordkeeping, client, tax and regulatory reporting, etc.
* Experience with wealth management and trust operations systems, technologies, and tools such as customer relationship management (CRM) systems, portfolio and trust investment accounting platforms, next-generation client portals, reconciliation tools, data warehouses, etc.
* You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:  

* Experience managing project deliverables, proposals, or sales presentations

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Vice President of Strategy

Job Summary  
The Vice President of Strategy is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and guiding the company's strategic direction. **POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Account Manager for Inland Services is responsible for strengthening customer relationships, driving service performance, and supporting business growth across assigned inland and final mile accounts. The role connects customer needs with Operations, Carrier Procurement, Pricing, and Systems to improve execution, resolve challenges, and identify opportunities for profitable growth.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own and strengthen relationships across an assigned portfolio, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor.
* Understand customer objectives, shipping patterns, delivery requirements, facility constraints, communication preferences, and success measures.
* Establish a consistent customer communication cadence that includes performance updates, issue follow-up, documented next steps, and business growth.
* Lead internal account reviews and strategic discussions that connect customer priorities with Mohawk Global inland and final mile solutions.
* Build long-term partnerships that support customer satisfaction, retention, and account expansion.
* Partner with operational teams, primarily Inland, Import Operations, and Business Development, to ensure pickup, linehaul, appointment, delivery, proof-of-delivery, and exception-management activities align with customer commitments.
* Guide service transitions and location launches while maintaining continuity and clear ownership.
* Develop and maintain account-specific SOPs, routing instructions, escalation paths, reporting requirements, and service standards.
* Monitor shipment and delivery performance, including on-time service, exceptions, accessorial activity, claims trends, and recurring operational gaps.
* Coordinate solutions for time-sensitive, high-touch, appointment, inside-delivery, liftgate, white-glove, expedited, and other specialized final mile requirements included in the customer solution.
* Promote complete and accurate shipment documentation, status updates, proof-of-delivery records, and customer-facing reporting.
* Own internal customer-impacting escalations from acknowledgement through resolution, recovery communication, and documented closure.
* Analyze service failures and performance trends to identify root causes, corrective actions, owners, and due dates.
* Balance customer needs, carrier capability, operational feasibility, cost, and contractual requirements when developing solutions.
* Proactively identify risks related to capacity, delivery constraints, recurring accessorials, communication gaps, claims, or service inconsistency.
* Escalate material commercial, financial, compliance, or customer-retention risks to the appropriate leader.
* Coordinate across Operations, Carrier Procurement, Pricing, Systems, Sales, and Leadership to deliver consistent account outcomes.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and other internal customer meetings using clear performance data, business insights, action plans, and growth recommendations.
* Communicate account health, opportunities, customer feedback, unresolved risks, and resource needs to leadership.
* Ensure handoffs between the internal customer, operations, and supporting functions are documented, timely, and understood.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to account support and operational team members as appropriate.
* Manage portfolio performance with accountability for retention, revenue growth, service quality, and overall account health.
* Identify opportunities to expand internal customer relationships through additional lanes, modes, locations, service levels, or complementary logistics solutions.
* Partner with Pricing and Operations to evaluate margin performance, accessorial trends, service costs, and solution sustainability.
* Maintain accurate account documentation, customer commitments, forecasts, opportunity records, and meeting notes.
* Support billing accuracy and timely resolution of internal customer disputes, rate discrepancies, accessorial questions, and documentation gaps.

**BENCHMARKS FOR MEASURING SUCCESS:**

* Maintains strong customer satisfaction and retention across the assigned portfolio.
* Improves on-time service, shipment visibility, delivery consistency, and issue-resolution performance.
* Completes scheduled business reviews and closes documented actions by agreed due dates.
* Reduces recurring escalations through root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Maintains current account documentation, SOPs, customer commitments, and performance reporting.
* Identifies and advances qualified opportunities for profitable account growth.
* Strengthens alignment and accountability across customer, operations, procurement, pricing, and systems teams.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Inland transportation and final mile delivery operations, terminology, service requirements, and exception management.
* Transportation management systems, shipment visibility tools, and customer reporting.
* Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for performance analysis, business reviews, and action tracking.
* SOP development, process documentation, KPI reporting, and root cause analysis.
* Working knowledge of pricing, accessorials, proof of delivery, claims, appointment delivery, and specialized delivery requirements.
* Strong problem-solving skills related to deliveries and cross-dock services within the international logistics industry.

**Business Skills:**

* Account management, customer retention, and consultative relationship development.
* Commercial awareness, opportunity identification, and solution development.
* Negotiation, expectation management, and conflict resolution.
* Data interpretation, performance storytelling, planning, and prioritization.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and urgent service issues while maintaining disciplined follow-through.

**Leadership Skills:**

* Ownership and accountability for account outcomes.
* Executive-ready communication and meeting facilitation.
* Cross-functional influence without direct authority.
* Sound judgment, decisive escalation, and disciplined follow-through.
* Coaching, knowledge sharing, and support of team development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, final mile operations, account management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer relationships and resolve complex service issues.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Experience using performance data and business reviews to drive corrective action and customer alignment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience working in TMS, CRM, or shipment visibility systems.
* Experience within a 3PL, freight brokerage, managed transportation, inland, import, or final mile environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience understanding complex internal client requirements and developing tailored, scalable transportation solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
* Experience with account implementations, SOP design, QBRs, margin review, and cross-functional improvement projects.

**OFFICE / WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

This position operates in a professional office environment (and/or remotely from a home office) with a quiet to moderate noise level and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such computers, photocopying machines and storage/filing cabinets. This is a largely sedentary role, however, lifting items under 25 pounds as well as the ability to bend, stand and walk short distances may be required.

**Travel Requirement:** Quarterly travel for customer visits, business reviews, facility meetings, and internal meetings.

75b8d536b76648575377.title: Director, Corporate Strategy
75b8d536b76648575377.description:
This Director position reports to the Chief Operating Officer and is located at the HealthVerity corporate office in Philadelphia. Remote hires will be considered but travel to Philadelphia on a regular basis is required.

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

As a leader on our corporate strategy team, you will be responsible for recommending a wide range of strategic actions based on your assessment of competitive, customer and market forces. Your ability to synthesize trends, build economic models and manage through the advantages and disadvantages of various transactions will be tantamount to your success. Furthermore, you will work closely with other teams such as Finance, Sales and Marketing to align on various operational dynamics in ensuring the operating effectiveness of the initiatives that you pursue. You will be a key contributor to the long-term strategic vision of the company as well as a catalyst for many of the short-term actions that are critical to our growth strategies.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and implement strategy to accelerate HealthVerity's strategic growth priorities
* Direct development and implementation of strategic initiatives to grow the organization through acquisitions, divestitures, partnerships, and similar opportunities
* Identify and evaluate growth opportunities, business model innovation and facilitate cross-business unit initiatives
* Be responsible for monitoring business trend outlooks and gathering competitive intelligence to contribute to strategic business planning discussions with leadership
* Evaluate and size market and customer segments, identifying growth areas for the company
* Form strategies and business cases to pursue high potential opportunities raised by yourself and other HealthVerity leaders
* Participate in all aspects in pursuing such opportunities that involve potential acquisition, divestiture, partnership or joint venture
* Play an integral role in establishing budgets and organizational structure to manage and oversee such opportunities
* Articulate and showcase the value of HealthVerity to potential partners and communicate partnership value to the HealthVerity leadership team

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in related field and a MPA, MPH, MBA or JD or comparable
* 3+ years of leadership with concentration in corporate and business development, strategic implementation, business planning or private equity/venture investing including experience in aspects of acquisitions, divestitures and collaborative transactions
* Track record of success in leading, complex initiatives and transactions such as development of new lines of business
* Background in corporate development or business development within healthcare delivery at an integrated delivery network, hospital system, law firm, investment bank, consulting or advisory firm, or comparable entity
* Excellent skills in strategic and quantitative analysis, problem solving, along with excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills to build trust, negotiate transactions and work with a broad group of executives

**Preferred**

* Track record of growth corporate strategy development and planning
* Identifies industry, market and emerging trends and creates insights and implications for the business
* Evaluates potential opportunities for organic and inorganic expansion and growth
* Ability to lead analysis, contemplate the strategic rationale for M&A opportunities and recommend high priority targets
* Actively builds market intelligence and competitive intelligence both to inform strategic decisions and the wider business development process
* Coordinate the execution of strategic initiatives, develop and track implementation plans to ensure the right level of focus and discipline required to achieve goals
* Works on special projects to evolve and enhance the broader corporate strategy community
* Leads and mentors' colleagues and is motivated by developing the capability and practice of the broader corporate strategy team

  

Base salary for the role is commensurate with experience and can range between $175,000 - 225,000 + annual bonus opportunity.

### **Hiring Locations**

Our main office is located in Center City, Philadelphia, where we operate on a hybrid model with in-office work required three days a week for local employees. We believe collaboration is most effective when teams come together, which is why we prioritize hiring in the Philadelphia area.

For certain roles, we also hire from **hub locations**—regions where we have an established presence with multiple team members working remotely. While these employees primarily work from home, we bring them together in person at least once a year for team-building, collaboration, and strategic planning.

Due to tax and labor regulations, we can only hire from specific states. Remote work is supported in the following key hub locations and approved states:

**Hub Locations:**

* Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
* Boston, Massachusetts
* New York City, New York
* Baltimore, Maryland
* Washington, D.C.
* Charlotte, North Carolina
* Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina
* Atlanta, Georgia
* Chicago, Illinois

**Approved States for Remote Work:**  
CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TN, and VA.

  

**About HealthVerity**

HealthVerity is the leader in privacy-protected real-world data exchange, transforming how healthcare and life sciences organizations connect and analyze disparate patient data. By enabling access to the industry's largest RWD ecosystem, HealthVerity supports critical applications in clinical development, commercial strategy, regulatory decision-making, and public health. To learn more about HealthVerity, visit healthverity.com.

  

**Why you'll love working here**

**We are making a difference** – Our technology is at the forefront of some of the biggest healthcare challenges in the world.

**We are one team** – Our people define our culture and always will. We take time out to celebrate each other, and acknowledge the value that each of us adds towards our greater mission. Come share all you have to offer.

**We are learners** – Every team member is continually learning, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or much longer. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our clients, partners, and each other.

  

**Benefits & Perks**

Our benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support and enrich the experience of our full-time employees, with eligibility limited to those in permanent positions.

* **Compensation:** competitive base salary & annual bonus opportunity (for non-commissioned roles)
* **Benefits:** We offer health, dental, and vision coverage starting on day 1. We also offer a 401(k) plan and an equity program, with new hire equity grants beginning at the Director level and above.
* **Flexible location:** Remote workdays and 3 days a week of in-office collaboration for team members in the Philadelphia area. Check location requirements with the recruiting team.
* **Generous PTO:** Take time off as needed, targeted at 4 weeks per year, including vacation, personal and sick time, plus paid parental leave.
* **Parental Leave:** 12 weeks paid leave for childbearing, surrogacy, and adoption; 6 weeks for non-childbearing parents.
* **Comprehensive and individualized onboarding:** mentorship program, departmental talks, and a library of resources are available beginning day 1 for each new team member to minimize the stress of starting a new job
* **Professional development:** biweekly 1:1s, hands-on leadership that is goal-and growth-oriented for each team member, and an annual budget to support professional development pursuits

We believe incorporating different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds make us stronger and encourages an environment where ageism, racism, sexism, ableism, homophobia, transphobia or any other form of discrimination are not tolerated. All qualified job applicants will be given consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. At HealthVerity, we're working towards an innovative and connected future for healthcare data and believe the future is better together. We can only do that if everyone has a seat at the table.

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to careers@healthverity.com

Remote opportunities are not available in all areas and require team members to work from a fixed location due to tax and labor law implications - specific questions about remote positions can be discussed during the interview process with your recruiter.

9e36576b47de6caa79b0.description:
CLIENT DELIVERY COORDINATOR

Paapri Cloud Technologies | PCT Flex

Location: Remote – United States, with travel to customer sitesEmployment Type: Full-TimeSalary: $60,000–$80,000 per year, depending on experienceDepartment: Professional Services / DeliveryReports To: General Manager

ABOUT PCT FLEX

PCT Flex is a manufacturing technology platform designed to help manufacturers operate more efficiently, differentiate their businesses, and stay competitive.

Our platform includes Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Warehouse Management (WMS), Production Scheduling, Quality Management, Product Lifecycle Management, machine connectivity, and other manufacturing applications.

PCT Flex is ERP-agnostic and can operate independently or integrate with enterprise systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, QuickBooks, and others.

Our mission is Transforming Manufacturing Through Innovation.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Client Delivery Coordinator to serve as the primary communication and coordination bridge between our US-based manufacturing customers and our offshore delivery team in India.

This is a customer-facing position requiring exceptional communication skills, strong organizational abilities, and the ability to work effectively across different cultures and time zones.

The Client Delivery Coordinator will work directly with customers to understand and document their business requirements, coordinate implementation activities, facilitate communication with our offshore teams, and ensure customer questions, concerns, and expectations are clearly understood and addressed.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with people, is an excellent listener, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of following through on commitments.

This position reports directly to the General Manager and works closely with offshore delivery management, functional consultants, technical teams, and project managers.

This is NOT a software development, solution architecture, or project management position. The primary focus is customer communication, requirements gathering, coordination, and follow-through.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION AND RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

* Serve as the primary day-to-day communication contact for assigned customers during implementation.
* Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders, business users, and operational personnel.
* Facilitate customer meetings, discussions, and follow-up activities.
* Ensure customer questions, concerns, and expectations are clearly understood and communicated to the appropriate delivery team members.
* Maintain professional, responsive, and consistent communication throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Build customer confidence through clear communication and dependable follow-through.
* Identify customer concerns early and communicate them to the General Manager and appropriate delivery personnel.

ONSITE–OFFSHORE DELIVERY COORDINATION

* Act as the primary communication bridge between US customers and our India-based delivery team.
* Facilitate collaboration across geographic locations, time zones, and working cultures.
* Ensure customer requirements, feedback, and priorities are accurately communicated to offshore teams.
* Coordinate meetings between customers, functional consultants, technical resources, and delivery management.
* Follow up on outstanding questions, clarifications, issues, and action items.
* Help offshore teams understand customer expectations regarding communication, responsiveness, deadlines, and business priorities.
* Identify communication gaps or misunderstandings early and facilitate resolution.
* Keep the General Manager informed of significant customer concerns and delivery dependencies.

BUSINESS REQUIREMENTS GATHERING

* Conduct customer interviews, discovery meetings, and business process discussions.
* Observe and document existing customer workflows and operational practices.
* Gather and organize business requirements in a clear, structured format.
* Document customer needs, process exceptions, operational challenges, and desired outcomes.
* Work with offshore functional consultants to clarify requirements and obtain additional information from customers.
* Coordinate customer review and confirmation of documented requirements.
* Maintain requirements documentation and track changes or clarifications.
* Ensure requirements are accurately communicated to functional and technical teams.

The Client Delivery Coordinator is responsible for understanding and documenting WHAT the customer needs, not designing HOW the software solution should work.

IMPLEMENTATION COORDINATION

* Coordinate day-to-day implementation activities between customers and offshore teams.
* Schedule and facilitate requirements workshops, demonstrations, testing sessions, and project discussions.
* Track action items, open questions, customer dependencies, and outstanding deliverables.
* Follow up with responsible team members to ensure timely responses and closure.
* Coordinate customer availability and participation in implementation activities.
* Support Project Managers and Delivery Managers by communicating progress, issues, and dependencies.
* Escalate risks, delays, or unresolved matters to appropriate management personnel.
* Provide regular updates to the General Manager.

TESTING, DEPLOYMENT AND GO-LIVE SUPPORT

* Coordinate customer participation in user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Organize testing sessions and facilitate communication between users and delivery teams.
* Document customer feedback, defects, and requested changes.
* Coordinate issue clarification, retesting, and customer confirmation.
* Assist with go-live planning, customer readiness, and training coordination.
* Serve as a communication point during go-live and post-implementation stabilization.
* Ensure customer issues are communicated, tracked, and followed through to resolution.

CROSS-CULTURAL COMMUNICATION AND COLLABORATION

* Promote effective communication and collaboration between US customers and offshore delivery personnel.
* Recognize and address differences in communication styles, business practices, and expectations.
* Facilitate discussions when language differences, terminology, or communication styles create misunderstandings.
* Ensure meeting outcomes, decisions, and commitments are documented and understood by all participants.
* Encourage clear, direct, respectful, and timely communication.
* Help create a positive customer experience while working with a globally distributed team.

REPORTING AND ACCOUNTABILITY

* Report directly to the General Manager.
* Provide regular updates on customer communications, open issues, requirements, and coordination activities.
* Maintain accurate meeting notes, action trackers, requirements documentation, and customer follow-up records.
* Escalate unresolved customer concerns, communication breakdowns, and delivery risks promptly.
* Collaborate with offshore delivery management while maintaining clear accountability to the General Manager.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in client coordination, software implementation, IT services, business analysis, or customer-facing technology roles.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong listening, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple customer discussions, action items, and follow-up activities.
* Comfortable working with internationally distributed teams and coordinating across time zones.
* Willingness to travel to customer facilities as required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience working with offshore IT delivery teams, particularly within an onsite–offshore delivery model.
* Experience in an IT consulting or professional services organization.
* Familiarity with manufacturing operations, ERP, MES, WMS, or enterprise software implementations.
* Experience working with manufacturing customers, including production, warehouse, quality, or operations personnel.
* Experience facilitating customer workshops and requirements discussions.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar collaboration and issue-tracking tools.
* Experience supporting software testing, implementation, and go-live activities.

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

* Exceptional communication and active listening
* Customer relationship management
* Cross-cultural communication
* Requirements gathering and documentation
* Meeting facilitation
* Onsite–offshore team coordination
* Organizational and follow-up skills
* Issue tracking and escalation
* Professionalism and customer empathy
* Ownership and accountability

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means customers feel heard, informed, and supported, while our offshore delivery teams receive clear requirements, timely feedback, and the information needed to execute effectively.

Performance will be measured by customer satisfaction, communication responsiveness, accuracy of requirements documentation, timely follow-up, effective onsite–offshore coordination, and successful support of implementation activities.

WHY JOIN PCT FLEX?

At PCT Flex, you will work directly with manufacturing companies to help them improve how they operate.

You will be part of a global technology team combining US customer engagement with offshore engineering and delivery capabilities.

This role offers an opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships, learn about manufacturing operations, and contribute directly to successful technology implementations without requiring a software development background.

PCT Flex – Transforming Manufacturing Through Innovation.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Paapri Cloud Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

Senior Manager, ServiceNow HRSD Program and Solution Management  
  
Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 11/20/2026  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
Deloitte is at the center of how Fortune 500 organizations are deploying and expanding HRSD, agentic AI and generative AI-powered employee experiences at scale. As a Senior Manager, you will take on broader ownership across the ServiceNow portfolio - leading engagement teams, shaping account strategy, and serving as a senior client advisor on how HRSD, conversational AI, large language models (LLMs), and intelligent automation can transform HR and IT service delivery across new implementations, use case expansions, and platform optimization efforts.  
  
You will be responsible for:  

* Leading concurrent ServiceNow HRSD engagements, including new implementations, use-case expansions, and optimization efforts; manage scope, budgets, staffing, timelines, risks, and delivery quality.
* Serving as the primary client relationship lead across account and program teams, building trusted-advisor relationships with senior HR, IT, and Information Security stakeholders, including director- and VP-level sponsors.
* Leading the design and integration of ServiceNow HRSD and AI Assistant solutions, including conversational AI, agentic workflows, enterprise search, and large language model (LLM)-powered knowledge retrieval, across ServiceNow, Workday, and other human resources information system (HRIS) and information technology service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Advising clients on responsible adoption of generative and agentic AI, including governance, data security, change management, and employee trust alongside technical configuration; identify and mitigate project risks, staffing gaps, and scope changes with senior leadership.
* Develop and mentor engagement teams; establish delivery standards and quality checkpoints; and drive account and practice growth through value propositions, business cases, proposals, scoping, pricing, client presentations, go-to-market activities, and thought leadership.

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.  
  
Our ServiceNow HRSD Team is at the forefront of delivering value-based HRSD solutions and applying generative AI and agentic AI to the employee experience, helping clients transform their HR and IT service delivery practices. We drive significant cost savings, increased efficiency, a stronger competitive advantage, and improved employee experience through intelligent automation, conversational AI, and agentic AI capabilities.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of enterprise platform implementation experience, including ServiceNow, Workday, or another HRIS
* 2+ years of experience delivering and implementing ServiceNow HRSD.
* 4+ years of experience managing client relationships with Director-level or above stakeholders
* 5+ years of experience leading programs with multiple concurrent workstreams across human resources, information technology, and information security.
* Ability to travel 0-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:  

* Advanced degree
* 8+ years of experience managing staff and leading teams.
* 8+ years of experience leading projects, including 2+ end-to-end deliveries, with responsibility for schedules, budgets, risks, weekly status reporting, and stakeholder governance.
* 8+ years of Big Four consulting experience, including business-development responsibilities and annual sales target attainment.
* 2+ years of experience with large language models (LLMs), generative artificial AI, or agentic AI solutions, including prompt design, model behavior, and responsible AI considerations.
* 2+ years of experience designing or implementing human resources shared service centers or employee service delivery transformations, including change management and adoption strategies for ServiceNow or AI-powered employee tools; and leadership of 2+ end-to-end ServiceNow HRSD or ServiceNow platform implementations.

WHO WE ARE
  
  
Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.
  
  
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
Join our team as the Security Operations Team Lead. You will lead a team of Security Operations Engineers, serve as incident commander for major incidents, and own the day-to-day health and improvement of our agentic SOC.
  
  
You will also run our customer zero program, in which we operate the Cyera platform on our own environment and feed what we learn back to Product. This is a player-coach role: you lead the team and stay hands-on.
  
  
The ideal candidate has 5 or more years in security operations or incident response, including senior or lead-level experience, has run significant incidents end to end, and has led or mentored engineers.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
**Team Leadership:** Lead, coach, and develop the Security Operations team; set priorities, run the operational cadence, and build career paths.
  
**Incident Command:** Direct the response to major incidents, make containment calls, manage stakeholder communication, and own the after-action process.
  
**SOC Operating Model:** Own the metrics and roadmap for the agentic SOC and prioritize the improvements that move them.
  
**Agentic Fleet Management:** Own the fleet of security agents that handle first-pass triage, investigation, and response: define guardrails and human approval points, evaluate accuracy, keep an audit trail, and report impact on autonomous handling and analyst capacity.
  
**Customer Zero Program:** Own posture goals, remediation governance, the product feedback loop, and reporting for our internal Cyera deployment.
  
**Detection and Response Strategy:** Set detection and response priorities with the Security Engineering lead based on threat model and coverage.
  
**Coverage:** Design and run on-call and coverage arrangements, including any external or follow-the-sun support.
  
**Hands-On Work:** Take the hardest investigations, build detections and playbooks, and write code, with AI-assisted workflows as the default way of working.
  
**Stakeholder Management:** Represent Security Operations to security leadership and R&D translate operational data into risk and status.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**  
**Experience:** 5 or more years in security operations, incident response, or detection engineering, including senior or lead-level work.
  
**Incident Command:** Experience running significant incidents end to end, including executive communication.
  
**Leadership:** Experience leading, mentoring, or managing engineers or analysts.
  
**AI-Assisted Workflows:** Hands-on experience running AI-assisted and agent-based security workflows, with a clear view of where agents are reliable, where they fail, and how to measure both.
  
**AWS Knowledge:** Strong knowledge of AWS security architecture, IAM, logging, and cloud incident response.
  
**AWS Certification:** AWS Security Specialty or Solutions Architect Associate, or equivalent demonstrated depth.
  
**Technical Depth:** Strong Python and detection engineering across SIEM and cloud telemetry; able to review and improve others' work.
  
**Operating Discipline:** Experience defining metrics, running an operational cadence, and reporting to leadership.
  
**Communication:** Clear with executives and engineers; calm and decisive under pressure.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
**Data Security:** Experience with DSPM, DLP, or operating a security product as an internal customer.
  
**Regulated Environments:** FedRAMP, SOC 2, or ISO 27001.
  
**Certifications:** GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, or similar.
  
  
﻿

Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease company focused on significantly improving outcomes for individuals with hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinism (HI). Our antibody therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is designed to treat all forms of HI and has shown substantial benefit in clinical trials and real-world use for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI) and tumor hyperinsulinism (tumor HI).

  

The Associate Director, Medical Affairs Operations will play a key role in supporting the implementation, coordination, and ongoing management of Medical Affairs operational capabilities, processes, systems, and infrastructure to enable effective execution of Medical Affairs strategies and initiatives.

  

Reporting to the Executive Director, Medical Affairs Strategy & Operations, this individual will translate established Medical Affairs priorities into operational plans, processes, and deliverables supporting pre-launch, launch, post-launch, and future pipeline activities. The position will support the Executive Director in advancing Medical Affairs operational capabilities, infrastructure, governance, and launch readiness, while maintaining alignment with functional leadership on priorities, resource allocation, and key operational decisions.

  

The successful candidate will combine strong project management skills, operational expertise, initiative, and attention to detail with the ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and collaborate effectively across functions. This individual will contribute to building scalable Medical Affairs infrastructure and operational processes appropriate for Rezolute's evolution into a commercial-stage organization.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Medical Affairs Operational Planning & Execution**

* Translate established Medical Affairs strategies and priorities into operational project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and tracking mechanisms.
* Manage assigned Medical Affairs operational initiatives and projects from planning through execution, ensuring alignment with approved objectives and timelines.
* Coordinate activities across Medical Affairs functions to support effective implementation of approved initiatives and launch readiness priorities.
* Develop and maintain integrated project trackers, operational dashboards, milestone reports, and risk and dependency logs.
* Facilitate operational planning meetings, document decisions and action items, and drive follow-through on assigned responsibilities.
* Identify operational challenges, resource constraints, and execution risks; recommend solutions and escalate significant issues to Medical Affairs leadership as appropriate.

**2. Medical Affairs Systems, Technology & Infrastructure**

* Coordinate implementation, administration, and ongoing optimization of Medical Affairs systems and technologies based on functional requirements, priorities, and governance established by Medical Affairs leadership.
* Support implementation and management of platforms such as Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault/PromoMats, and other relevant Medical Affairs technology solutions.
* Partner with Information Technology, Compliance, functional stakeholders, and external vendors to coordinate system configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* Develop and maintain standardized workflows, system documentation, user guidance, and training resources.
* Coordinate system onboarding, user access, troubleshooting, and process enhancements to support effective adoption and utilization.
* Identify and recommend opportunities to improve operational efficiency, data management, reporting, and knowledge sharing through technology.

**3. Medical Affairs Governance, Compliance & Process Management**

* Coordinate drafting, implementation, maintenance, and periodic review of Medical Affairs standard operating procedures (SOPs), policies, and operational processes under the direction and oversight of Medical Affairs leadership and appropriate functional stakeholders.
* Support implementation and administration of governance processes for Medical-Legal-Regulatory (MLR) review, HCP interactions, advisory boards, medical education, grants, congress activities, and other Medical Affairs programs.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, templates, tracking tools, and records to support compliance, consistency, and inspection readiness.
* Collaborate with Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and other functions to ensure operational processes are aligned with applicable requirements and approved company policies.
* Support periodic process assessments, internal audits, and corrective or preventive actions as appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize workflows and implement approved process improvements.

  

**4. Medical Affairs Programs & Launch Readiness**

* Provide operational and project management support for Medical Affairs programs, including Field Medical, Medical Communications, Medical Information, Medical Education, congress activities, advisory boards, and external scientific engagements.
* Coordinate timelines, logistics, vendors, documentation, and deliverables associated with assigned Medical Affairs initiatives.
* Support implementation of Medical Affairs launch readiness plans, including operational infrastructure, systems, processes, training coordination, and functional preparedness.
* Track progress against established launch milestones, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate updates to Medical Affairs leadership.
* Partner with Medical Affairs functional leads to facilitate timely, consistent, and compliant execution of approved programs.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders as appropriate to support operational alignment and execution.

  

**5. Budget, Resource & Vendor Management**

* Support Medical Affairs leadership in budget development, forecasting, and resource planning through preparation of financial data, tracking reports, and operational analyses.
* Manage assigned activities related to expense tracking, purchase orders, invoices, contracting workflows, and budget reconciliation.
* Coordinate vendor identification, onboarding, contracting, and ongoing management in accordance with approved procurement processes and Medical Affairs leadership direction.
* Monitor vendor deliverables, project timelines, performance, and expenditures against approved budgets and contractual expectations.
* Maintain accurate records of vendor agreements, financial commitments, and operational expenditures.
* Identify opportunities to improve vendor coordination, resource utilization, and operational cost efficiency.

  

**6. Operational Metrics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain operational dashboards, reporting tools, and performance tracking mechanisms aligned with Medical Affairs leadership-defined objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Coordinate collection, consolidation, and reporting of operational data across Medical Affairs systems, programs, and functional teams.
* Prepare periodic operational performance reports, project updates, and launch readiness summaries for Medical Affairs leadership.
* Monitor execution against approved operational plans and identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend and implement approved process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, consistency, scalability, and accountability.
* Support ongoing evaluation and refinement of Medical Affairs operational processes and infrastructure as organizational needs evolve.

  

**7. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Coordination**

* Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Information Technology, Patient Affairs, and other relevant functions to facilitate coordinated operational execution.
* Support implementation of cross-functional workflows and processes that enable effective collaboration while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs functional independence and compliance requirements.
* Facilitate communication, information sharing, and resolution of operational dependencies across internal and external stakeholders.
* Represent Medical Affairs Operations in assigned project teams, working groups, and operational meetings, communicating progress, challenges, and recommendations to Medical Affairs leadership.
* Support implementation of leadership decisions and ensure appropriate operational follow-through across affected stakeholders.

  

**8. Other Responsibilities**

* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications & Expected Capabilities**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare, business administration, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 5–7 years of relevant experience within the biopharmaceutical industry, including experience in Medical Affairs operations, project management, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience supporting Medical Affairs operational activities, systems, infrastructure, and processes within a pharmaceutical or biotechnology organization.
* Familiarity with core Medical Affairs capabilities, including Field Medical, Medical Communications, Medical Information, Medical Education, congress activities, and external scientific engagements.
* Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing Medical Affairs technology platforms, including Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault/PromoMats, or comparable systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of Medical Affairs governance, SOPs, MLR processes, and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects independently, establish executional priorities within approved direction, identify dependencies and risks, and drive deliverables through completion.
* Experience coordinating vendors, contracts, budgets, purchase orders, and financial tracking processes.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, project management tools, and operational reporting systems.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners in a matrixed environment.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to balance independent execution with appropriate communication, escalation, and alignment with functional leadership.
* Experience in rare diseases, specialty therapeutics, launch preparation, or growing biotechnology organizations preferred.
* High degree of accountability, adaptability, initiative, integrity, and commitment to operational excellence and compliance.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Practice Coordinatorto support daily radiology practice operations, ensure efficient workflows, monitor case status and turnaround times (TAT), and maintain exceptional client service.

This role is responsible for tracking pending cases, identifying delays, coordinating issue resolution, maintaining operational records, and escalating concerns to the Practice Manager or VP of Operations as needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

Practice Operations & Case Management

* Coordinate daily operations to support efficient workflows and consistent service delivery.
* **Monitor case queues, pending studies, turnaround times, and outstanding issues to ensure timely case processing and reporting.**
* Identify delays, workflow interruptions, and operational concerns; follow up with appropriate personnel through resolution.
* **Maintain accurate records of case follow-ups, delays, and unresolved issues.**
* Ensure compliance with established operational procedures and escalate urgent or recurring concerns appropriately.

**Communication & Client Relations**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned facilities and internal teams regarding daily operational needs.
* **Communicate professionally and promptly with facility directors, technologists, radiologists, and other healthcare personnel.**
* Respond to inquiries, coordinate resolution of case-related concerns, and provide timely updates on delays or outstanding issues.
* **Identify recurring service or communication concerns and report them to the Practice Manager.**

**Reporting & Administrative Support**

* Prepare and maintain operational reports tracking case volume, turnaround times, delays, and outstanding issues.
* **Provide updates on daily activities, unresolved concerns, and operational trends.**
* Participate in team meetings and assist with workflow improvements, procedural updates, and operational initiatives.
* **Complete administrative assignments and special projects as directed by the Practice Manager or VP of Operations.**

**Team Collaboration**

* Collaborate with the Practice Manager, other Practice Coordinators, and internal departments to maintain operational coverage and resolve workflow, technical, scheduling, and communication issues.
* **Track assigned tasks through completion and support consistent communication across teams.**
* Assist with additional operational duties as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree
* **Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-up capabilities.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* **Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.**
* Ability to identify problems, coordinate solutions, and escalate issues appropriately.
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word.**
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with radiology workflows, imaging studies, and medical terminology.

**Performance Expectations**

* Maintain timely follow-up on pending cases, delays, and operational concerns.
* **Communicate promptly with facilities and internal teams to support timely case resolution.**
* Maintain accurate records and complete reports and assignments by established deadlines.
* **Escalate urgent issues and recurring operational concerns appropriately.**

20525f629a0a96e587ce.title: Head of Product Launch Program Management (Rare Disease)
20525f629a0a96e587ce.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare and difficult-to-treat diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity.

Rezolute’s lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage clinical development for the treatment of hypoglycemia due to congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI). As Rezolute expands its medical and scientific focus into tumor-related hyperinsulinism (tumor HI), most commonly related to pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (insulinomas) or paraneoplastic hypoglycemia (NICTH), the company is committed to advancing novel therapeutic strategies that address this rare and complex form of hypoglycemia associated with insulin-secreting tumors and related neuro-oncology disorders.

More information can be found at rezolutebio.com

The Director, Product Launch Program Management is a member of the Program Management Office (PMO), reporting to the Senior Vice President, Operations, and directly supporting the Commercial Product Launch Lead (Head of Marketing). The PLPM owns the integrated launch plan by indication and by market across the U.S. and priority ex-U.S. countries, and facilitates, consolidates, organizes, documents, and measures that plan so the Product Launch Lead and functional leaders can make decisions and deliver against it. The role supports establishment of the launch strategy with specific responsibility to make it complete, current, and executable. Working within the company’s governance model, the role works daily within the PMO enabling coordination, dependency determination, awareness and cross functional planning with program managers supporting the Development and Technical Operations teams.

Success requires a working understanding of each contributing function’s scope of work, with emphasis on critical coordination of Commercial, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Supply and Quality, and the ability to engage the working team credibly on scope, tasks, dependencies, risks, and outcomes. As Rezolute advances concurrent launches across multiple indications in the U.S. and ex-U.S., this role may expand to build and manage a team of Launch Program Managers.

This can be a remote role based in the United States, with travel as necessary to Rezolute headquarters in Redwood City, CA, and to launch team, partner, and ex-U.S. working sessions.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Launch Plan Ownership**

* Own a single, authoritative integrated launch plan (ILP) by indication and by market, covering scope, tasks, owners, timelines, critical path, and cross-functional dependencies, including shared versus indication-specific workstreams.

* Consolidate inputs from Commercial, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Clinical, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Legal, and reconcile conflicts in timing, assumptions, and ownership.

* Manage plan changes through PMO governance, re-baselining when scope, indication sequencing, or timing changes and communicating impacts to the team.

**Facilitation & Day-to-Day Coordination**

* Facilitate launch team and working team meetings on behalf of the Head of Operations and/or Product Launch Lead, driving agendas and pre-reads to document decisions, actions, and ownership.

* Works daily with amongst the launch working team to communicate, coordinate, influence, problem solve and drive issue resolution; escalate critical-path issues, dependencies and risks in a timely way, with options.

* Coordinate Launch Readiness Reviews (LRR) and day-of-approval and launch-window execution plans, and capture lessons learned for subsequent indication and country launches.

* Assemble, facilitate, coordinate, manage and document cross functional sub teams driving alignment.

* Support Head of Operations, Executive Leadership and enterprise functions including IS&T.

**Documentation, Measurement & Reporting**

* Maintain the launch plan record set, including RACI, decision log, risk and issue register, and change log, so the current state of each launch is always clear.

* Develop and maintain readiness criteria, dashboards, and KPIs by indication and market; track variance to baseline; and report status to the Product Launch Lead, the Head of Operations, the enterprise PMO, and executive and Board forums.

**U.S. & Ex-U.S. Market Entry**

* Maintain country-level plans for priority ex-U.S. markets with regional leads, distributors, and partners, tracking regulatory, pricing and reimbursement (HTA), supply, and market-entry milestones.

* Work with the Development team Program Manager to integrate Expanded Access Program (EAP) and ex-U.S. Named Patient Program (NPP) activities, enabling to internal and external coordination toward NPP sales, and the transition of clinical trial, open-label extension, EAP, and NPP patients to commercial supply in each market.

**Team Leadership (as the launch portfolio expands)**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of Launch Program Managers supporting concurrent U.S. and ex-U.S. launches, and establish common PMO standards, tools, and templates.

### **Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS, PharmD, or PhD) preferred.

**Experience**

* 7+ years in a similar role with broad program management responsibility for a biotech therapeutic; rare disease strongly preferred.

* Hands-on ownership of an integrated launch plan (ILP) through at least one product launch, from approximately 24 months before approval through post-launch; concurrent, multi-indication, first-in-company, or biologic launch experience preferred.

* Familiarity with ex-U.S. Named Patient Program sales, Expanded Access Programs, and ex-U.S. distribution or partnered market entry (e.g., distributor or licensing-partner models).

* Experience managing or mentoring program managers preferred.

* Proficiency with Smartsheet, MS Project, or equivalent tools; PMP or related certification a plus.

**Functional Knowledge**

**Working knowledge of the launch scope of work for:**

* **Commercial:****marketing, market access, pricing, trade and distribution, patient services,** **data warehousing and commercial operations,** **and field readiness**

* Medical Affairs: medical strategy, scientific communications, medical information, field medical, and evidence generation

* Supply and Quality: commercial supply readiness, demand and supply planning, packaging and labeling, and distribution; compliance, inspection readiness, QMS and Quality integration across all GxP functions, plans and activity

* Regulatory: rare-disease pathways (e.g., Orphan Drug Designation, Breakthrough Therapy, Priority Review, PRIME, conditional approval) and how regulatory milestones drive launch timing

**Competencies**

**The successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* Plan ownership: Organized and disciplined; keeps the plan, records, and status accurate and current.

* Functional credibility: Engages function leads and task owners on scope, tasks, dependencies, risks, and outcomes based on experience and specific understanding of their work.

* Communication and influence: Clear in writing and in the room, from the working team to executive and Board audiences; influences without authority as a service-oriented partner to the Product Launch Lead and functional leaders.

* Resolution and escalation: Resolves issues and solves problems at the working level; escalates early, with facts and options.

* Remote effectiveness: Self-directed across time zones; willing and able to travel as necessary, including internationally.

* Direct multi-tasked execution and ownership: comfort working within a fast paced, agile, hands on environment

0cd2fd44c554fc28697e.description:
**About Diversified:**  
Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  
**What to Expect:**  
At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
Diversified is seeking a VP, Global Supply Chain to lead the global distribution network supporting our AV and Media installation and managed services business, comprising 30 warehouses and 12 forward operating bases across North America, Europe and Australia. This position holds full accountability for the movement of equipment and material from PO tracking, receipt through staging, kitting, deployment to job sites, and reverse logistics on completed projects.
  
The network currently operates on both Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Great Plains, with the international locations on separate ERP systems, supported by manual processes and spreadsheet-based tracking, without a warehouse management system. Operating practices vary across locations, inventory is reconciled manually, and visibility into material in transit is limited. The international locations operate independently of the North American organization, each with its own systems and processes.
  
The Vice President is responsible for both daily operations of the warehouses and the outcome of the modernization program that addresses these conditions. A Manager of Supply Chain Process & Systems reports to this position and leads execution of the modernization work, including WMS selection and implementation, supplier EDI integration, and tracking automation. The Vice President serves as executive sponsor of that program and is accountable for its delivery.
  
**Location:** Virtual (U.S. Remote)
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Network operations
  

* Own operating performance across all warehouse and forward operating base locations globally.
* The international locations in Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, and Australia are not currently managed as part of a centralized supply chain function. They operate on separate ERP platforms with independent processes, vendor relationships, and inventory practices. This position is responsible for consolidating those locations into a single global function with common standards, reporting, and system direction, while accommodating genuine regional requirements
* Manage the operating budget, including labor, freight cost, and third-party services, and deliver performance against plan
* Own headcount planning across all locations, including staffing models by site, use of temporary and contract labor to meet workload demand and span of control
* Identify and deliver cost reduction across the network, and build the business case for investment where it produces a return
* Establish and enforce consistent operating standards across sites for shipment tracking, receiving, put-away, cycle counting, staging, kitting, pick/pack, shipping, returns, and RMA handling
* Define the performance measurement framework for the network, including inventory accuracy, on-time staging to project schedule, dock-to-stock cycle time, shrink, cost per shipment, space utilization, and labor productivity. Several of these metrics are not currently tracked and will require definition and baselining
* Partner with Technical Operations to align material delivery with installation schedules
* Evaluate and recommend network footprint decisions in partnership with regional Tech Ops leadership, including forward operating base openings, consolidations, and closures based on project density and service-level requirements

Inventory control
  

* Establish inventory accuracy as a managed metric, transitioning from periodic physical audits to ongoing cycle counting
* Implement controls over customer-owned, project-allocated, and company-owned inventory, including serialized asset tracking
* Reduce excess, obsolete, and unallocated inventory and establish the review cadence to maintain reductions
* Own reconciliation between physical inventory and financial records in partnership with Finance

Program sponsorship
  

* Hold accountability for the business outcomes of the warehouse modernization initiative, which is executed by the Manager of Warehouse/Inventory Process & Systems in partnership with Business Systems
* Approve the operating design underlying the program, recognizing that process standardization decisions are operational rather than technical
* Provide the organizational authority required for adoption, including directing site leaders to implement new processes and resolving conflicts between local preference and network standards
* Ensure program resourcing is maintained and that reallocation of program capacity to operational demands occurs only through deliberate tradeoff decisions
* Co-own the investment request and business case and present to the EVP and Finance
* Escalate and resolve supplier and carrier performance issues affecting integration commitments

Commercial and vendor management
  

* Manage carrier, 3PL, and warehouse lease relationships, including rate negotiation, performance scorecards, and service recovery
* Own cross-border logistics, customs, duty, and trade compliance for international movement of equipment, in partnership with Finance and Legal
* Own supplier relationships at the escalation level, including data quality and ASN compliance commitments

Leadership and organizational development
  

* Lead a globally distributed team of warehouse managers, supervisors, inventory specialists, and logistics coordinators across North America, Europe, and Australia
* Define roles, establish performance standards, and develop site leadership capable of operating to company standards without central oversight
* Lead the organization through process and system change, including management of resistance to transitioning away from established manual practices
* Develop the Manager of Supply Chain Process & Systems toward expanded supply chain leadership responsibility

QUALIFICATIONS
  
Required
  

* 12+ years in supply chain, distribution, or logistics, including 5+ years leading multi-site operations preferably across more than one country or region
* Experience managing a multi-site operating budget and headcount plan, including labor models, flexible staffing, and cost performance against plan
* Demonstrated record of standardizing operations across locations previously managed independently
* Experience as business sponsor or owner of a systems implementation such as WMS, ERP, or TMS. Technical configuration experience is not required; accountability for adoption and business outcomes is
* Working knowledge of ERP-driven distribution operations; Microsoft Dynamics 365 familiarity preferred
* Experience operating in a multi-ERP environment, including consolidation, harmonization, or migration of disparate systems
* Experience building and presenting business cases and operating results to executive leadership
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred
  

* Project-based distribution experience in AV, low-voltage, construction, telecommunications, or comparable industries where material flows to job sites on scheduled installation dates
* Forward operating base, field depot, or field staging model experience
* Experience managing distribution operations in Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, or Australia, including cross-border compliance, customs, and VAT or duty considerations
* Serialized asset and customer-owned inventory management
* Experience integrating distribution operations following acquisition

#Li-Remote
