a307fdf5f89550e98631.title: Customer Support Manager (Remote)
a307fdf5f89550e98631.description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**AECOM** is seeking a highly qualified, **Customer Support Manager** to lead the CTrides customer support center. This role will primarily be a remote position, with the caveat that training will be in person, and the team may be required to attend in person meetings and trainings in the office and the remote work is subject to change.

The role centers on three things: developing the team, controlling the quality of what customers get, and making the operation work better over time. The Customer Support Manager is accountable for the full customer experience, including training, quality, procedures, scheduling, and service improvement. The goal is a support operation that runs efficiently, meets project and customer expectations, and builds customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.

The successful candidate will lead the Customer Support team and hold it to clear standards for service quality and accountability. The selected individual will be the point of contact for onboarding and ongoing training so staff know the policies, procedures, and systems and handle customers well.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:

* Coach and mentor each team member through regular one-on-ones, performance feedback, and clear development goals. Use QA findings and performance data to decide where training and coaching are needed most.
* Prepare and lead team meetings, training sessions, performance reviews, and operational updates. Run a structured QA program that reviews a consistent sample of calls, emails, chats, web inquiries, and case documentation against defined service standards.
* Maintain the QA scorecard and standards and hold calibration sessions so reviewers score consistently. Review automated responses, including the AI agent and chat automation, and flag errors and gaps for correction.
* Track trends in QA scores, customer feedback, and performance metrics, and report findings to leadership. Use what QA turns up to fix problems, whether that means coaching someone, updating training, or correcting the knowledge base.
* Work with the Program Director to identify ways to improve support tools, workflows, and automated customer responses, and help set priorities for changes. Give input and help test during system changes and rollouts, and train staff on what’s different afterward.
* Own the content of the knowledge base, standard operating procedures, job aids, FAQs, and training materials, and keep it accurate and current. Monitor how the AI agent and chat automation perform with customers and identify where they fall short.
* Use Zendesk, databases, reporting tools, and standard office software to track service levels, workload, and quality results. Build a strong understanding of Connecticut transportation programs, services, routes, schedules, and mobility resources. Make sure staff know CTrides policies, practices, and service standards, including how to handle service alerts and disruptions.
* Work with transportation providers, partners, and stakeholders to gather, verify, and keep current route, schedule, and service information. Take ownership of escalated and complex customer issues, see them through to resolution, and communicate outcomes clearly to customers and stakeholders.
* Support representatives with day-to-day challenges. Provide accurate, courteous support by phone, email, web platforms, and other channels, and step in as a representative when needed.
* Build and maintain team schedules with enough staffing to cover service.
* Manage workload and resources, and monitor attendance, time-off requests, and schedule changes to protect service levels. Keep accurate records of customer interactions, resolutions, quality reviews, and departmental activity.

  
**Qualifications**

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

* BA/BS + 6 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
* Valid U.S Driver's License and as a condition of employment, must pass AECOM's Motor Vehicle Records Review

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* 6 years of customer service experience, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role leading a customer support team
* Experience helping improve support tools, workflows, or knowledge content
* Demonstrated experience training, coaching, and developing staff, including running onboarding programs
* Demonstrated experience running QA reviews and using the results to improve coaching and processes
* Experience with customer support platforms such as Zendesk or similar ticketing and case management systems
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
* Proven experience using management methods and techniques
* Familiarity with AI agents or chat automation in a customer service setting.
* Awareness of current customer service technology, trends, and applications

  
**Additional Information**  

* Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position
* Relocation assistance is not available
* Primarily weekday hours. Some weekend work required to support service coverage, QA, and training
* Primarily a general office environment, with occasional travel to project or client sites
* Ability to lift up to 30 lbs

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

f361fc27a24730f7908b.title: Senior Director, Risk Management & Insurance (Remote)
f361fc27a24730f7908b.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Senior Director, Risk Management & Construction Risk serves as the Company's senior risk leader and trusted advisor to executive leadership. This role is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive risk management strategy that supports the Company's operational, financial, and growth objectives.  
  
The Senior Director provides enterprise-wide leadership across risk management, insurance, surety, claims, contractual risk transfer, alternative risk financing, and loss prevention. Working closely with Operations, Preconstruction, Safety, Fleet, Finance, Human Resources, and Legal, this leader ensures risk management is integrated into key business decisions and project execution strategies.  
  
This position will play a critical role in strengthening the Company's risk profile, enhancing surety capacity, reducing total cost of risk, and evaluating sophisticated risk financing solutions, including captive insurance and self-insurance structures.  
  
This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

Enterprise Risk Management & Strategic Leadership:

* Lead and continuously enhance the Company's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and the Board on enterprise, operational, financial, contractual, and emerging risks.
* Develop and maintain enterprise risk assessments, risk registers, and key risk indicators (KRIs).
* Establish executive-level risk reporting and dashboards that support informed decision-making.
* Facilitate enterprise risk reviews and strategic planning discussions across business functions.
* Identify and evaluate emerging risks impacting construction operations, workforce planning, project delivery, market conditions, cybersecurity, environmental exposures, and regulatory compliance.
* Participate in major business initiatives, acquisitions, geographic expansion opportunities, and strategic investments to provide risk-based guidance.

Construction Risk & Operational Partnership:

* Partner closely with Operations and Preconstruction teams to assess risk associated with project pursuits and execution.
* Support go/no-go decisions through evaluation of project-specific risks, contract structures, delivery methods, labor availability, financial exposure, and owner qualifications.
* Assist project leadership teams in identifying and managing operational risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk assessment protocols for large, complex, or non-traditional projects.
* Participate in strategic reviews of major projects and emerging operational exposures.

Insurance Program Leadership:

* Provide executive oversight of all corporate and project-specific insurance programs, including:
  + General Liability
  + Workers' Compensation
  + Commercial Automobile
  + Umbrella and Excess Liability
  + Builder's Risk
  + Professional Liability
  + Pollution Liability
  + Property Insurance
  + Cyber Liability
  + Executive Liability Coverages
* Lead annual insurance renewals and long-term insurance strategy development.
* Negotiate coverage structures, retentions, limits, and pricing with brokers and insurance carriers.
* Maintain strong relationships with insurers, brokers, and underwriting partners.
* Evaluate emerging insurance solutions and recommend program enhancements.
* Benchmark insurance programs against industry peers and best practices.
* Oversee insurance audits and ensure accurate reporting and premium allocations.
* Manage project-specific insurance placements and controlled insurance programs (OCIPs/CCIPs) when applicable.

Alternative Risk Financing & Captive Strategy:

* Lead the evaluation and development of alternative risk financing strategies.
* Conduct feasibility studies related to captive insurance, self-insurance, large deductible programs, and other risk-retention structures.
* Develop financial models evaluating Total Cost of Risk (TCOR), reserve requirements, and long-term financial impact.
* Partner with actuaries, captive managers, legal counsel, auditors, and tax advisors to develop recommendations.
* Present business cases and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Oversee implementation and governance of approved alternative risk financing programs.

Surety Program Management:

* Lead the Company's surety bonding strategy and program management.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with surety companies, brokers, and underwriters.
* Monitor aggregate bonding capacity and ensure alignment with backlog and growth objectives.
* Coordinate financial and operational reporting for surety partners.
* Negotiate bond terms, rates, collateral requirements, and program structures.
* Provide executive leadership with forecasting and analyses regarding surety capacity and future project opportunities.

Claims Management & Loss Reduction:

* Provide strategic oversight of all workers' compensation, liability, builder's risk, automobile, environmental, and professional liability claims.
* Establish claims management practices that reduce claim frequency, severity, and overall cost.
* Manage complex, high-severity, and litigated claims in partnership with legal counsel and third-party administrators.
* Monitor claim development, reserve adequacy, and litigation strategy.
* Analyze loss trends and identify opportunities for operational improvements and enhanced loss prevention.
* Report significant claims activity and risk exposures to executive leadership.

Contract Risk Transfer & Legal Partnership:

* Oversee review and negotiation of risk-related provisions within:
  + Construction contracts
  + Subcontracts
  + Joint venture agreements
  + Design agreements
  + Professional service agreements
  + Vendor contracts
  + Equipment leases
  + Real estate development agreements
* Partner with Legal and Operations teams to negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance, warranty, and dispute resolution provisions.
* Establish and maintain company-wide contractual risk standards and review processes.
* Ensure contractual obligations align with insurance coverage and corporate risk tolerance.

Safety, Fleet & Loss Prevention Partnership:

* Partner with Safety and Fleet leadership to develop enterprise-wide loss reduction strategies.
* Utilize claims and operational data to identify trends and target high-risk activities.
* Support initiatives designed to reduce workers' compensation, general liability, and fleet-related losses.
* Review and monitor key performance indicators, including:
  + Experience Modification Rate (EMR)
  + OSHA metrics
  + Incident rates
  + Vehicle accident trends
  + Near-miss reporting
  + Safety audit results
* Quantify and communicate the financial impact of safety and risk-control initiatives.
* Present integrated Risk, Safety, and Fleet performance reports to executive leadership.

Leadership & Team Development:

* Build and lead a high-performing risk management organization.
* Mentor and develop team members while establishing a strong succession pipeline.
* Foster a collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and business partnership.
* Champion a proactive risk culture throughout the organization.
* Serve as the organization's primary resource for risk management education and awareness.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field required.
* MBA, Master's Degree in Risk Management, or related advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise risk management, project risk, construction risk, insurance, or operational risk within EPC, industrial construction, energy, infrastructure, or related sectors.
* Significant experience managing large-scale insurance and risk financing programs.
* Demonstrated success overseeing surety programs supporting large and complex construction projects.
* Experience with captive insurance, self-insurance, large deductible programs, or alternative risk financing structures strongly preferred.
* Proven track record managing complex claims and litigation matters.
* Experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams and Boards of Directors.
* Strong understanding of construction operations, project delivery methods, and contractual risk environments.

**Preferred Professional Certifications:**

* CPCU (Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter)
* CRM (Certified Risk Manager)
* ARM (Associate in Risk Management)
* CRIS (Construction Risk and Insurance Specialist)
* ACI (Associate in Captive Insurance)

**Key Competencies:**
---------------------

* Strategic Leadership & Business Acumen
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Construction Operations Knowledge
* Insurance & Alternative Risk Financing Expertise
* Surety & Contract Risk Management
* Financial Analysis & Total Cost of Risk Modeling
* Executive Communication & Board Presentation Skills
* Negotiation & Relationship Management
* Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence
* Data Analytics & Decision-Making
* Team Development & Organizational Leadership

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

SOLV Energy prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind against an employee or applicant based on race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, or ethnicity, mental or physical disability, veteran status, parental status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

4b21c5bbb7027cf2506f.title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist
4b21c5bbb7027cf2506f.description:
Senior Growth Marketing Specialist

STI Federal is seeking a mission-driven **Senior Growth Marketing Specialist** to serve as the marketing engine of our federal growth strategy. Partnering with Business Development and Capture, this role builds visibility with agencies, primes, and teaming partners and converts it into qualified pipeline.

**Who We Are & What We Do…**

At STI Federal, we drive growth through strategic government contracting, fulfilling our mission to support the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians. Our company reinvests 100% of its profits into tribal businesses or community programs, enhancing the well-being of over 52,000 tribal citizens. Our work empowers federal agencies and strengthens some of the nation’s most critical initiatives, while fostering opportunities for skilled professionals to make a meaningful impact.

**What You’ll Do…**

**Key Responsibilities & Expected Outcomes**

**Growth Strategy & Business Development Alignment**

* Partner with Business Development and Capture leadership to build and execute an annual growth marketing plan aligned to target agencies, priority pursuits, contract vehicles, and the recompete calendar.
* Translate the opportunity pipeline into account-based campaigns aimed at specific agency program offices, contracting activities, OSDBU offices, and large-prime teaming partners.
* Position STI Federal’s tribally owned status, socioeconomic designations, and differentiators in market-facing messaging that supports set-aside, direct-award, and teaming strategies where applicable.
* Participate in BD pipeline reviews to keep marketing priorities synchronized with capture timelines.

**Conference, Trade Show & Industry Event Marketing**

* Build and manage the annual event calendar (e.g., AFCEA, NDIA, AUSA, ACT-IAC, agency industry days, OSDBU matchmaking events, and tribal business forums), recommending where to attend, exhibit, or sponsor based on pipeline alignment and expected return.
* Represent and market STI Federal at conferences, trade shows, industry days, and matchmaking sessions: staff the booth, deliver the company pitch, and initiate conversations with government buyers, prime contractors, and prospective teaming partners.
* Drive pre-event targeting: identify priority attendees, agency speakers, and exhibiting primes; secure meetings for BD and executive leadership; and run pre-show LinkedIn and email outreach.
* Capture, qualify, and log all event leads and contacts in the CRM within 48 hours of each event, and coordinate disciplined post-event follow-up with Business Development.
* Measure and report event performance (meetings secured, qualified contacts, teaming conversations initiated, and opportunities influenced) to inform future event investment decisions.

**Booth, Exhibit & Collateral Operations**

* Own end-to-end exhibit execution: registration, booth space selection, exhibitor deadlines, shipping and drayage, electrical and internet orders, and on-site setup and teardown.
* Order, design, and maintain conference booth materials and inventory, including backdrops, banners, table throws, displays, signage, lead-capture tools, and branded promotional items, in alignment with brand standards.
* Produce event-ready collateral, including capability statements, agency-specific one-pagers, contract vehicle sheets, and leave-behinds tailored to each event’s audience.
* Manage event and sponsorship budgets and vendors, and prepare booth staff with target lists and talking points so every representative engages on message.
* Ensure promotional items, hospitality, and event engagement with government personnel comply with federal ethics and gift rules.

**Capture & Proposal Marketing Support**

* Maintain the capability statement library, past performance write-ups, and company boilerplate used across capture, proposals, RFIs, and sources sought responses.
* Produce proposal graphics, win-theme visuals, and branded templates in partnership with the proposal team.

**Digital Presence & Content**

* Maintain the corporate website as an authoritative “briefing room” communicating capabilities, NAICS codes, contract vehicles, and past performance, with full ADA and Section 508 compliance.
* Translate complex technical services into mission-focused web content, capability sheets, whitepapers, newsletters, and proof points in partnership with SMEs and leadership.
* Lead the company’s LinkedIn presence and executive thought-leadership campaigns, and amplify STI Federal’s event presence before, during, and after each conference.

**Pipeline Attribution & Performance**

* Track and report marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline with BD, tying campaigns and events to opportunity outcomes.
* Route inbound agency and teaming inquiries to Business Development, and ensure no sensitive BD, capture, or nonpublic information enters public-facing materials.

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities for Success**

* Working knowledge of the federal acquisition lifecycle, from sources sought through award and recompete, and how marketing accelerates each stage.
* Confident, polished in-person presence; able to engage senior government officials, prime contractor executives, and small business liaisons on the conference floor.

* Strong project and vendor management skills, with a collaborative approach to working alongside BD, SMEs, and leadership.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), CMS and analytics tools, and design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva); able to convert technical concepts into clear, persuasive content.
* Demonstrates commitment to STI Federal’s core values and excels in a collaborative team environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, Marketing, Digital Media, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Experience:**

* 5+ years of marketing experience in a business-to-government (B2G) or federal contracting environment supporting business development or growth.
* Hands-on experience planning and executing conferences and trade shows, including booth logistics, materials ordering, and vendor management.
* Experience managing corporate websites and producing capability-based content.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Advanced degree or certifications in marketing, digital marketing, or related specialties; APMP certification a plus.

**Experience:**

* Experience marketing for a tribally owned, 8(a), or other small business federal contractor.
* Experience with federal market intelligence platforms (e.g., GovWin IQ, Bloomberg Government, HigherGov).
* Experience producing proposal graphics or supporting proposal operations.

**Work Environment**

* **Environment:** Climate-controlled office or remote setting, with up to 25% domestic travel to conferences and industry events, including occasional evenings and weekends.

* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to stand for extended periods and lift booth materials up to 40 lbs, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**STI Federal is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.** We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, disability, ethnicity/race, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or veteran status. Native American preference applies when candidates meet qualifications equally.

STI Federal participates in the Electronic Employment Verification Program. Learn more about E-Verify.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

Anduril is seeking a highly skilled, mission-driven, highly organized, detail-oriented, and responsive **Staff Program Manager** to provide critical tactical support and operational oversight for our strategic defense clients, driving the adoption, expansion, and long-term success of Anduril's cutting-edge Rocket Motor Systems. You will serve as a trusted advisor, deeply understanding client operational requirements and translating them into impactful solutions that leverage our solutions. This role requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, technical aptitude, exceptional relationship-building skills, and a passionate commitment to national security. In addition, this role achieves results by focused on the day-to-day management of client accounts, ensuring the smooth deployment, ongoing functionality, and optimal performance of Anduril's Rocket Motor Systems. You will be the primary point of contact for operational queries, issue resolution, logistics coordination, and direct support to ensure our military and government customers' success.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

* **Strategic Client Engagement:**
* + Serve as the lead point of contact for key defense accounts focused on Rocket Motor Systems, establishing and nurturing strong, enduring relationships with military leadership, program offices, and operational end-users.
  + Develop a deep understanding of client mission objectives, operational environments, and strategic priorities to proactively identify and position Anduril's Rocket Motor Systems.
  + Navigate complex government procurement processes, contracting mechanisms (e.g., DIU, SBIR, OTA), and funding cycles to ensure successful program execution and growth.
  + Champion client needs internally, collaborating closely with Anduril's Engineering, Product, and Integration teams to inform product roadmap and ensure timely, high-quality solution delivery.
* **Daily Client Operations & Support:**
* + Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing day-to-day communications, operational requests, and urgent support needs related to Rocket Motor systems.
  + Address client inquiries promptly and effectively, providing direct solutions or coordinating with internal technical support, engineering, and logistics teams for rapid resolution of issues.
  + Track and document all client interactions, support tickets, and operational feedback in the CRM system (e.g., Salesforce) with meticulous detail.
  + Ensure clients receive timely updates on product enhancements, revisions, and relevant technical documentation.
* **Solution Adoption & Growth:**
* + Drive the successful adoption and integration of Anduril's Rocket Motor systems into client operations, demonstrating clear mission value and operational superiority.
  + Identify and cultivate opportunities for expansion within existing accounts, including upselling new features, capabilities, cross-selling adjacent Anduril technologies, and securing follow-on contracts.
  + Develop comprehensive account plans, sales strategies, and proposals that align with client requirements and Anduril's strategic objectives.
  + Conduct compelling technical demonstrations, presentations, and product briefings to diverse audiences, from technical specialists to general officers.
* **Tactical Execution & Deliverables:**
* + Coordinate the scheduling and logistics for product demonstrations, training sessions, and field support visits with clients and internal teams.
  + Monitor the operational status and usage data of deployed Rocket Motor systems, proactively identifying potential issues or areas for improvement in coordination with technical teams.
  + Process and track client orders for system upgrades, spare parts, consumables, and additional training modules.
  + Facilitate contract renewals by ensuring all terms and conditions of current agreements are met and documented.
  + Prepare and deliver routine operational status reports, usage metrics, and support summaries to clients and internal stakeholders.
* **Internal Coordination & Problem Solving:**
* + Act as the liaison between client operational teams and Anduril's internal engineering, product, and field support teams to ensure client requirements are accurately relayed and understood for immediate action.
  + Troubleshoot basic technical issues on-site or remotely, escalating complex problems to the appropriate technical experts.
  + Support the integration and qualification and testing of new Rocket Motor system by coordinating client access and feedback.
  + Assist in identifying and documenting client needs for future product features based on immediate operational feedback.
* **Performance & Reporting:**
* + Forecast and track key account metrics, including revenue targets, program milestones, and operational deployment success.
  + Provide regular, insightful reports to internal leadership on account status, strategic opportunities, competitive landscape, and challenges.
  + Manage contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms that support long-term partnerships and Anduril's business goals.
* **Domain Expertise & Market Intelligence:**
* + Maintain an expert-level understanding of Anduril's Rocket Motor system portfolio, including technical specifications, operational advantages, and future development pathways.
  + Stay abreast of industry trends in rocket motor systems, applications and defense technologies, as well as evolving national security threats and doctrine.
  + Gather and synthesize client feedback and market intelligence to contribute to Anduril's product development and competitive strategy.
* **Compliance & Documentation:**
* + Ensure all client activities comply with contractual agreements, security protocols, and relevant government regulations.
  + Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, contact information, and equipment inventory.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education & Experience:**
* + Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science), Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  + 8-10+ years of progressive experience in program/project management, sales, or business development within the defense, aerospace, or government contracting sector.
  + **Experience with military operations, rocket motor systems, missile, ballistics, or complex technical product support is highly preferred.**
  + **Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain one, is required.**
  + Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and maintain exceptional attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  + Proven track record of successfully managing complex client relationships and closing significant contracts with U.S. government entities (DoD, IC, etc.).
  + Prior military experience, especially in an operational or procurement role related to advanced systems, is a significant advantage.
* **Skills & Competencies:**
* + Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  + Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a capacity to connect client needs to innovative technical solutions.
  + Proficiency in using CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) for documentation, tracking, and reporting. Includes program management tools.
  + Ability to coordinate logistics, schedules, and resources efficiently.
  + Highly responsive, proactive, and client-focused with a strong sense of urgency.
  + Demonstrated ability to negotiate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
  + Relentless commitment to supporting national security missions and delivering operational excellence.
  + A deep sense of mission and commitment to strengthening national security through technological innovation.
  + Ability to travel frequently (up to 50% or more) to client sites, operational environments, and Anduril facilities as required.

  

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

546ac5a7d8aa96a694d9.title: Telemetry Specialist
546ac5a7d8aa96a694d9.description:
Eastern Lift Truck Co.
  
Fleet Technology Specialist
  
Currently, we are seeking a Fleet Technology Specialist to join our Equipment Technology and Fleet Solutions team. This position will provide technical field support for our fleet technology products while also helping develop new business opportunities for safety camera systems and other Equipment Technology solutions.
  
This role will be approximately 50% project management and customer support and 50% sales support and business development. We are seeking a technically inclined, customer-focused individual who is comfortable working with customers, technicians, sales representatives, manufacturers, and internal team members. The ideal candidate will be able to independently manage field-based projects while identifying opportunities to grow our Equipment Technology business throughout Eastern Lift Truck’s operating footprint.
  
We offer tremendous opportunities for growth, competitive compensation and benefits for individuals who want a career with a great company that maintains a family feel!
  
  
**Main Duties:**  
Serve as a primary customer resource for Eastern Lift Truck’s Equipment Technology products and solutions.
  
Coordinate customer projects from initial demonstration through implementation and ongoing support.
  
Develop new business opportunities for safety camera systems and other Equipment Technology solutions.
  
Work with existing customers to identify opportunities to improve forklift safety, fleet visibility, operator awareness, and facility safety.
  
Conduct product demonstrations, presentations, and Equipment Technology evaluations with customers.
  
Partner with sales representatives to identify opportunities, support customer meetings, and develop new and existing accounts.
  
Educate Eastern Lift Truck’s sales team on Equipment Technology products, applications, capabilities, and customer solutions.
  
Coordinate with customers, sales representatives, technicians, administrators, and manufacturers to support successful customer projects.
  
Assist with system commissioning and customer handoff, working with technical resources as needed for installation and troubleshooting.
  
Provide customer training and ongoing product support following implementation.
  
Follow up on customer inquiries, demonstrations, quotations, projects, and sales opportunities.
  
Maintain strong customer relationships and a high level of customer service.
  
Perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
Strong technical aptitude and willingness to learn new technologies and products.
  
Excellent communication, presentation, customer service, and relationship-building skills.
  
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  
Self-motivated and comfortable working independently and collaboratively across teams.
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and standard business applications.
  
Previous customer service, technical support, sales, or business development experience preferred.
  
Experience with fleet technology, telemetry, camera systems, material handling equipment, or related technology preferred.
  
Material handling or forklift industry experience a plus.
  
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel regularly throughout Eastern Lift Truck’s operating footprint, including occasional overnight travel.
  
  
**Compensation:**  
**Annual base salary:** $65,000 - $75,000. This position is eligible for commission.
  
Compensation will be based on experience.
  
  
**Benefits:**  
Company car/car allowance with fuel card, company cell phone and laptop; medical, dental, vision, and prescription plan; 401(k) with partial company match; paid vacation and sick days; paid holidays; short- and long-term disability; and basic/supplemental life insurance policies.
  
  
**Who is Eastern Lift Truck Co.?:**  
Eastern Lift Truck Co., is a family-owned company, celebrating over 50 years strong. We provide sales, parts, rentals and service in all areas of the Lift Truck, Material Handling and Allied product business. At Eastern Lift Truck Co. we know that the employees are the ‘heart and soul’ of the company.
  
**Find out more at:** Eastern Lift Truck Co.
  
“Eastern Lift Truck Co. is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer including Disabled/Vets.”

ac7aeaece344c7e18e11.title: Assistant Store Manager
ac7aeaece344c7e18e11.description:
**About the Job:**  
Our values start with our people, join a team that values you! We are the nation's largest off-price retailer with over 2,000 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

As part of our team, you will experience: Success our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving career growth. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow teamwork. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution our commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion, and our community. We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 7 distribution centers nationwide. With 2025 revenues of $22.7 billion, we are a fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

Come see what's in store: https://jobs.rossstores.com/creative/about.

**General Purpose:**  
The Assistant Store Manager is a member of the Store Leadership who is responsible for a specific, assigned area of the Store as well as the general operations and supervision of the Store when functioning as the Manager on Duty. Assistant Store Managers are responsible for opening and closing the Store, supervising Associates, and maintaining a friendly, easy to shop environment. They ensure proper merchandise presentation and maintain a clean work area at all times. You are also responsible for executing and supervising Company operational processes as needed.

**Essential Functions:**

**Maintaining Safe & Secure Environments:**

* Understands that safety is the number one priority and practices safe behaviors in everything they do.
* Maintains a high level of awareness on the sales floor to create a safe and secure shopping environment for everyone. Immediately corrects or reports any unsafe conditions or practices to Store Leadership.
* Responsible for security of building including entrance/exit control (Associate entry/egress, receiving door, daily trash removal, etc.), Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS) device daily function check, Cash Office security, armored carrier pick-ups and register area.
* Removes clutter and ensures safe, clear egress to emergency exits. Responsible for Customer safety including accident prevention, accident reporting and emergency procedures. Tests all fire alarm systems as scheduled. Responds to after-hours alarms when requested.

**Customer Service:**

* Treats all Customers, Associates, and other leaders with respect. Demonstrates courtesy, friendliness, and professionalism at all times. Recognizes Associates using Company recognition programs.
* Personal and Store Brand.
* Represents and supports the Company brand at all times. Maintains a professional appearance, in accordance with Company Dress Code. Ensures all Associates adhere to the Company Dress Code at all times. Keeps all areas of the Store clean, well-maintained, and merchandised to standard. Responsible for daily trash removal.

**General Merchandising:**

* Ensures recovery, sizing and markdowns are completed to Company standards through teaching, assigning tasks, and following up per Company best practice. Responsible for receiving merchandise truck when needed. Processes all merchandise with a sense of urgency. Responsible for receipt of all non-merchandise inbound deliveries (i.e. signs, supplies, special deliveries, etc.). Responsible for cleanliness and organization of all Stockrooms. Helps deliver and place merchandise on sales floor when all merchandise is processed. Responsible for ensuring any back-stock is secured and processed to Company policy. Responsible for merchandising of department including the back stock. Responsible for the reduction of loss due to damage. Ensures compliance to the monthly presentation guidelines in assigned area. Responsible for floor moves and signing including promotional signing as needed. Responsible for re-wraps as needed.

**Loss Prevention:**

* Understands and complies with the Loss Prevention Awareness Program and is responsible for Store Loss Prevention which includes maintaining a large Customer service presence on the sales floor, Customer and Associate engagement and heightened Loss Prevention awareness.
* As a representative of Ross Leadership, demonstrates integrity and honesty in all interactions with Associates and Customers.
* Safeguards confidential information, cash and credit card information and merchandise.
* Ensures Public View Monitor (PVM) system is maintained properly.
* Conducts "Code 50" package inspections. Executes all Company Best Practices and maximizes productivity by minimizing steps and touches while working.

**Front End Supervision and Operations:**

* Executes all Company Best Practices and maximizes productivity by minimizing steps and extra touches when working.
* Ensures Associates are executing to Company standards at the Front End.
* Maintains pace, energy and "presence" at the Front End, managing the line to expedite Customers wait time trains and coach Associates on cash registers, shortage control policies and other Frontend procedures.
* To meet friendly and productivity standards.
* Controls Retail Associates' break schedule for backups, lunches and breaks.
* Ensures all equipment is working properly.
* Maintains proper supplies and recovery for the Frontend area.
* Ensures go backs are expedited, properly scanned, security tagged and ticketed.
* Teaches all Associates the "Scan and Bag" best practice.
* Ensures salability of merchandise on the Front End, aisle tables, Men's/Women's 4-way features, and specialty racks.

**Fitting Rooms:**

* Responsible for the maintenance and cleanliness of the Fitting Rooms.
* Ensures all Fitting Room garment tags are audited and accounted for to Company policy.
* Ensures go-back compliance throughout the day.
* All merchandise returned to the sales floor must be ticketed, scanned, nubbed and security tagged as needed.

**Administrative Duties as Assigned by Store Manager:**

* Ensures Cash pulls and bank deposits are conducted to Company policy.
* Responsible for Front End control when needed.
* Understands and adheres to the policies and procedures that refer to refund approval, Associate purchase approval, securing tills and cash in safe, register Paid Outs/Ins, void approval, register media and break schedules.
* Responsible for payroll administration including daily punch edits, Associate scheduling compliance, Sunday payroll transmission and Payroll reporting as needed.
* Other duties as assigned by Store Manager.

**Competencies:**  
Manages work processes business acumen plans; Aligns & Prioritize Builds Talent collaborates leading by example communicates effectively ensures Accountability & Execution.

**Qualifications and Special Skills Required:**

* Excellent verbal communication skills. Fluency in English. Prior Customer Service and supervisory experience preferred.
* Familiarity with point-of-sale equipment and applications.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations commonly used in retail environments. Ability to work evenings and weekends.

**Physical Requirements/ADA:**

* Ability to use all Store equipment, including PDTs, registers and PC as required.
* Ability to spend up to 100% of working time standing, walking, and moving around the Store.
* Ability to regularly bend at the waist, squat, kneel, climb, carry, reach, and stoop.
* Ability to occasionally push, pull and lift more than 25 lbs.
* Ability to use janitorial equipment, rolling racks, ladders and other assigned supplies.

**Disclaimer:**  
This job description is a summary of the primary duties and responsibilities of the job and position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive or all-inclusive listing of duties and responsibilities.

Ross is an equal employment opportunity employer. We consider individuals for employment or promotion according to their skills, abilities and experience. We believe that it is an essential part of the Company's overall commitment to attract, hire and develop a strong, talented and diverse workforce. Ross is committed to complying with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination based on race, color, religious creed, age, national origin, ancestry, physical, mental or developmental disability, sex (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), veteran status, military status, marital or registered domestic partnership status, medical condition (including cancer or genetic characteristics), genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, as well as any other category protected by federal, state or local laws.

fccf2c2080151cfa7912.title: Customer Service Representative II
fccf2c2080151cfa7912.description:
**About Us:**

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company — it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

**About the Role:**

The Tier 2 Customer Service Representative is the first escalation point for phone calls and digital engagements, a resource for Customer Service Representative I (CSR I) team members, and the owner of pharmacy operations follow-up for orders that do not move through fulfillment on their own. CSR II assists the cases a CSR I cannot resolve within their authority, works with our partner pharmacies to resolve order issues and settle shipment claims, and contacts patients whose orders are held for address or other information problems. This role also carries live chat coverage in addition to phone and queue work. Like CSR I, this role is non-clinical and covers all five telehealth verticals - weight management, women's health, men's health, urgent care, and mental health. This representative does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment guidance.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Frontline support -** 80% of the role will remain handling inbound customer calls and messages, while acting as an additional resource for CSR1 chat questions while TLs and Supervisors aren’t available
* **Serve as the first escalation point** - take escalations from CSR I team members on calls, chats, email, SMS, and portal messages, and take over the engagement when the patient needs a higher level of authority or a more experienced hand.
* **Resolve escalated situations** - handle upset or escalated patients, billing and refund exceptions above CSR I authority, and complex account issues, using de-escalation skills in both live and written conversation.
* **Escalate clinical concerns immediately** - route clinical questions, adverse events, and safety/urgent concerns directly to licensed clinical staff per escalation protocol, regardless of channel. Clinical escalations do not pass through CSR II first.
* **Hand off beyond-authority cases** - pass cases beyond CSR II authority to the Customer Service Team Lead with a complete summary, so the patient does not have to repeat their story.
* **Support CSR I team members** - answer process, policy, and system questions in real time and point CSR I to the correct knowledge base article, SOP, or resource. This is peer support, with no formal supervisory authority over CSR I.
* **Improve knowledge resources** - report knowledge base gaps, outdated articles, and recurring CSR I questions to the Team Lead.
* **Escalate stuck orders to the pharmacy** - identify orders stalled in processing or fulfillment and escalate them to the responsible pharmacy through that pharmacy's designated channel (email for some pharmacies, Jira for others), then track each escalation to resolution.
* **Manage shipment claims** - file claims for lost, damaged, and delayed shipments, monitor each claim's progress, and make the adjustments needed to keep replacements, reships, and refunds in line with the SOP.
* **Run stuck order patient outreach** - contact patients whose orders are held for bad addresses, incomplete addresses, or other missing information by phone, SMS, and patient portal message, collect the corrected details, and pass them to the pharmacy so the order can ship.
* **Staff live chat** - cover live chat during assigned shifts and manage multiple concurrent chats while keeping quality and empathy on every conversation.
* **Respond to inbound contacts across every channel** - phone, live chat, email, SMS, and in-app/patient portal messaging - across all five verticals, meeting channel-specific SLAs (real-time for phone and chat; asynchronous windows for email and SMS).
* **Make outbound calls** - for appointment reminders, onboarding check-ins, refill reminders, subscription renewal, retention/win-back outreach, and satisfaction follow-ups, as the shift requires.
* **Support account, scheduling, and order needs** - assist with account, subscription, and scheduling issues and share order and fulfillment status without interpreting dosing, side effects, or treatment efficacy.
* **Verify identity before discussing PHI** - confirm patient identity per HIPAA and company policy before sharing any protected health information, on any channel.
* **Handle billing within authority** - process or route billing, payment, refund, and cancellation requests within defined policy and authorization limits.
* **Document every interaction** - log complete, accurate notes in the CRM/helpdesk/telephony platform, tagged by channel, vertical, and issue type, including every pharmacy escalation, claim, and outreach attempt with its status and next step.
* **Flag emerging trends** - identify recurring issues (platform bugs, shipping delays, pharmacy backorders, carrier problems) and report them to the Team Lead.
* **Meet individual KPIs across every channel worked in a given shift** - for response/handle time, resolution rate, quality score, and customer satisfaction (CSAT).
* **Stay current on policy** - complete required training on workflows, promotions, and policy changes across all five verticals.

 **Requirements**  

* High school diploma or equivalent.

* 1+ year of customer service experience - phone-based, chat/digital-based, or both.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills - clear, empathetic, and accurate in both formats.
* Comfortable navigating multiple software systems simultaneously (CRM/helpdesk, telephony, telehealth platform, knowledge base, and pharmacy escalation tools such as email and Jira) and switching between them within a shift.
* Ability to type efficiently while on a live call, and to manage multiple concurrent chats when off the phone.
* Willingness to be trained on and consistently follow HIPAA/PHI handling requirements.
* Ability to learn and accurately apply program information across all five verticals - this role is organized by tier, not by vertical or by channel, so cross-program fluency is required from day one.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 12+ months of prior experience in healthcare, telehealth, pharmacy, or e-commerce fulfillment customer service, on phone or digital channels.
* Experience with shipping carriers, claims, or order exception handling.
* Experience with Jira or a similar ticketing tool.
* Outbound sales, retention, or win-back call experience.
* Familiarity with subscription/e-commerce billing models.
* Bilingual (Spanish/English or other) a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Compensation: $24-26/hour
* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, Roth 401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Short Term Disability
* Training & Development

879cf76f3d06d7242df1.title: Customer Service Representative II (Remote)
879cf76f3d06d7242df1.description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**AECOM** is seeking a highly qualified, **Customer Support Representative II** to join our Customer Support Center team supporting the CTrides Program. This role will primarily be a remote position, with the caveat that training will be in person, and the team may be required to attend in person meetings and trainings in the office and the remote work is subject to change.

The Customer Support Representative is the first point of contact for CTrides customers by phone, email, chat, and web. The representative answers questions, solves problems, documents every contact, and passes complex cases up so customers get the right answer the first time.

The role reports to the Customer Support Manager, and weekend work is part of the regular schedule. The goal is a join a team that will support the CTrides operation to ensure the program runs efficiently, meets project and customer expectations.

The successful candidate will follow clear standards for service quality and accountability. The selected individual will know the policies, procedures, and systems and handle customers well.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:

* Answer customer questions by phone, email, chat, and web, accurately and courteously.
* Give customers current information about Connecticut transportation programs, services, routes, schedules, and mobility resources, including active service alerts and disruptions.
* Resolve issues on the first contact whenever possible. Escalate complex or sensitive cases to the Customer Support Manager following established procedures.
* Follow up with customers until their issue is closed out.
* Use plain language and adjust to each customer’s needs, including accessibility needs.
* Document every interaction in Zendesk with clear notes and the right categories.
* Follow CTrides service standards, policies, and procedures.
* Take part in QA reviews and use the feedback to improve.
* Attend training, team meetings, and coaching sessions, and keep up with program and service changes.
* Use the knowledge base as the main source for answers, and flag anything that is missing, unclear, or out of date.
* Tell the Customer Support Manager about trends in customer questions and complaints.
* Work the assigned schedule, including weekend shifts, and give advance notice of time-off requests.
* Help teammates and cover gaps when service needs change.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  
**Qualifications**

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

* HS + 2 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
* 1 year of customer service experience by phone, email, or chat.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Dependable attendance and availability for the assigned schedule, including weekends.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Associate’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with Zendesk or a similar ticketing or case management system.
* Contact center experience.
* Experience in public transportation, transit, or public-sector customer service.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including accurate, professional writing.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Able to juggle multiple customer contacts and stay calm and professional with frustrated customers.
* Willing to help teammates when things get busy.

  
**Additional Information**

5341ad51aac7729c238f.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Why this role is on the menu**
================================

The CX Vendor Manager leads the performance and continuous improvement of Instacart's outsourced Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) network, and builds and manages a team of Associate Vendor Managers to do it. This role is critical to ensuring consumers, shoppers, and retailers receive world-class support through a scalable global network of Customer Service Representatives. As a subject matter expert in vendor management, you will lead complex programs across the CX Organization, contribute to the Vendor Management team's strategy, and act as a thought partner to leaders across the company. The role is fast-paced and data-driven, and calls for someone who can make tough, well-informed decisions, think long-term, and develop people while delivering measurable outcomes.

**About the Team**
------------------

The CX Shopper Pillar team at Instacart is dedicated to providing the best possible customer experience. We are passionate about understanding customer needs and using data-driven insights to improve processes and drive innovation. We work collaboratively across the organization to ensure our customers have a seamless and enjoyable experience with Instacart.

  

**What you'll cook up in your first year**
==========================================

**People Leadership**
---------------------

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of Associate Vendor Managers, including goal setting, regular feedback, performance reviews, and career growth.
* Build team capability by setting clear expectations, delegating effectively, and creating a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and succession planning for the Vendor Management team.
* Allocate work and priorities across the team to balance vendor coverage, project delivery, and individual development.

**Strategy**
------------

* Actively contribute to the development and implementation of the Vendor Management team's strategy to support company objectives.
* Apply broad expertise to help set functional objectives and roadmaps, weighing both known and intangible factors to make sound, long-term decisions.

**Project & Performance Management**
------------------------------------

* Lead complex projects and programs within the Pillar and CX, and contribute to large-scale initiatives with non-CX cross-functional partners that drive overall performance.
* Engage with CX and non-CX management teams while leading projects.
* Own vendor performance across the BPO network, ensuring KPIs, SLAs, and headcount requirements are met, with day-to-day oversight carried out through your team.
* Oversee vendor escalations and corrective action plans, stepping in on the highest-impact issues.
* Guide vendor onboarding and off-boarding, and oversee invoice review and management to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely resolution of discrepancies.

**Data & Analysis**
-------------------

* Drive continuous improvement in quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness across support processes and teams, using a data-driven and customer-centric approach.
* Lead and coach the team on root cause analyses of performance variances, turning findings into action.

**Partnership & Influence**
---------------------------

* Partner with cross-functional teams in CX, Operations, Business Development, Product, and Engineering to drive results for our customers.
* Partner with Training and Quality Assurance teams and vendors to deliver strong agent onboarding, ongoing training, and high-quality support standards.
* Build collaboration and engagement with vendor leadership to create a high-performance vendor environment, and ensure process and procedure compliance across all BPO partners.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and readouts on projects and initiatives, and help your team do the same.
* Offer recommendations for improvement and build supportive relationships with stakeholders within and outside the team.

**Operational Support**
-----------------------

* Manage multiple strategic and tactical priorities with broad scope in a fast-paced environment, with effective communication and follow-through.

**The secret ingredients we're looking for**
============================================

**Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6-8 years of experience leading support projects of varying size and complexity, including scaled support and/or outsourcing operations.
* Experience managing, coaching, and developing people.
* Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with experience presenting complex information clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Exceptional analytical and reporting skills, with a data-driven mindset.
* Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Strategic thinker who can make sound decisions with a long-term view, while consulting managers and peers for guidance.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to create and execute project plans effectively.
* Open to travel (up to 25%) domestically and internationally.

**Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)**
-------------------------------------------------

* Advanced degree, or certification in business management, strategic planning, or project management.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting and case management.
* Customer-centric mindset and passion for driving operational excellence.
* Experience fostering collaboration and driving engagement among teams.

**MANDATORY: PRIOR ELEVATOR SERVICE INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE REQUIRED. APPLICANTS WITHOUT DIRECT ELEVATOR INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.**

**About Thrive Elevator Advisors**

Thrive Elevator Advisors is a rapidly growing independent elevator advisory firm, representing commercial property owners and managers across the United States.

We help clients reduce elevator maintenance costs, improve service performance, resolve billing issues, and hold elevator service providers accountable.

We are expanding our customer service team and seeking an experienced elevator industry professional who understands how elevator service companies operate and takes pride in delivering exceptional customer service.

**Position Overview**

The Elevator Customer Service Specialist serves as a primary point of contact between our clients, elevator service providers, and internal operations team.

This position requires someone who understands elevator maintenance and service field operations including a strong working knowledge of; service calls Preventative maintenance, outages, callbacks, and the importance of holding service providers accountable.

The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of elevator service sales/ account management worked in customer service, service coordination, dispatch, account management, or branch administration for an elevator service company.

**This is not an entry-level position. Prior elevator industry experience is mandatory.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service & Client Relations**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned commercial property management clients.
* Respond promptly and professionally to client inquiries, elevator outages, and service concerns.
* Build strong relationships with property managers, asset managers, and elevator service providers.
* Provide proactive updates and ensure clients receive timely resolutions.
* Deliver a consistently exceptional customer experience.

**Elevator Service Coordination**

* Open, manage, and track elevator service tickets through resolution.
* Coordinate with elevator service providers regarding outages, callbacks, repairs, inspections, and maintenance issues.
* Follow up persistently with elevator companies to ensure service commitments are met.
* Escalate unresolved issues to branch managers and regional leadership when necessary within the Service Providers organization
* Monitor outstanding service issues and maintain accurate records of communications and resolutions.

**Contract & Administrative Support**

* Assist with elevator maintenance contract administration and provider communications.
* Identify and help resolve billing discrepancies, service deficiencies, and contract compliance issues, negotiating on the customer’s behalf and securing fair market pricing
* Support new client onboarding and account transitions.
* Maintain accurate customer records, service histories, and account information.
* Assist with client reporting and dashboard updates.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Prior professional experience working directly as an Elevator Service Representative or equivalent position — mandatory.**
* Experience working for an elevator service provider, including Otis, Schindler, KONE, TK Elevator, Mitsubishi Electric, Fujitec, or an independent elevator contractor.
* Experience in elevator customer service, service coordination, dispatch, or account management, or branch operations.
* Working Strong knowledge of elevator maintenance contracts, service calls, callbacks, outages, and repair coordination.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and CRM or service management systems.
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.

**What Makes Someone Successful at Thrive**

**Exceptional Customer Service:** You take pride in delivering a premium, highly responsive client experience.

**Ownership & Accountability:** You take responsibility for issues and follow through until they are resolved.

**Industry Knowledge:** You understand elevator company operations, service departments, and how to navigate provider organizations effectively.

**Persistence:** You are comfortable following up with elevator companies and escalating matters when necessary.

**Professionalism:** You communicate confidently and diplomatically with clients, technicians, branch managers, and executives.

**Initiative:** You identify opportunities to improve processes, solve problems, and deliver better service.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation based on elevator industry experience.
* Full-time, remote position.
* Benefits discussed during the interview process.
* Opportunity for professional growth within a rapidly expanding organization.

**Why Join Thrive?**

Thrive Elevator Advisors is changing how commercial property owners manage their elevator service relationships.

Unlike traditional elevator service companies, we work exclusively on behalf of property owners and managers, helping them secure better pricing, stronger service commitments, and greater accountability from their elevator providers.

You'll join a collaborative, growing organization where your elevator industry experience will be valued and your work will directly influence client satisfaction and company success.

**Important Application Requirement**

**DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU HAVE PREVIOUSLY WORKED IN THE ELEVATOR INDUSTRY.**

We are specifically seeking candidates with direct elevator industry experience. General customer service, property management, or facilities management experience alone does not satisfy this requirement.

Please include the name of the elevator company or companies you previously worked for and a brief description of your responsibilities when applying.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote
