da70134943cee5ad5031.title: Customer Service Rep Call center
da70134943cee5ad5031.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

**Entity: Corporate Services**

**Department: Call Center**

**Location: 3930 Chestnut Street/Remote \*\* Employees must live within PA, MD, NJ, or DE**

**Hours: Full-Time, M-F 8:30am-5:00pm**

**Summary:**

The Customer Service Representative (CSR)in the Marketing Contact Center (MCC) serves as the "face" of Penn Medicine The position offers excellent patient-centric Customer Service to those seeking guidance and medical assistance from the University of Pennsylvania Health System (UPHS).

The CSR provides information and access to Penn Medicine-owned and affiliated physicians, program services, and educational classes. S/he responds to multi-channel inquiries from patients, physicians, employees, etc., regarding all services offered within the Marketing Contact Center in accordance with established guidelines.

The CSR provides patients and customers with referrals to physicians and services and assists patients with appointment requests via inbound phone calls or online requests and web chat. S/he handles physician-to-physician calls (Physician Link), event and class registration, international calls, cancer calls, and transfer of care requests. In addition, the position is responsible for making outbound calls in response to web or digital marketing campaign inquiries.

The Customer Services Representative must display human qualities of empathy, compassion, kindness, and patience. The position must exemplify Penn Medicine Core Values and exhibit solid Customer Service skills, a patient-centric attitude, a collaborative team spirit, and the ability to think critically and quickly**.**

**Accountabilities**

DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Offers excellent patient-centric Customer Service to those seeking guidance and medical assistance from the University of Pennsylvania Health System (UPHS).
* Answers inbound calls for Penn Medicine Referral Service lines to provide information and access to Penn Medicine owned and affiliated physicians, program services, and educational events; provides resources to callers.
* Provides appropriate and age-specific Penn Medicine resources.
* Gathers information from caller using skills that elicit information for appropriate and efficient responses.
* Provides Penn Medicine patients and customers with referrals to physicians and services and assists patients with appointment requests and other services via inbound phone calls or online requests and web chat.
* Performs searches and uses online reference resources to provide appropriate Physicians/services.
* Facilitates requests for appointment scheduling; provides information and performs appropriate warm transfer.
* Registers callers for events and classes using software (and Pennmedicine.org).
* Obtains/enters demographic information on new callers; verifies demographic information for existing patients.
* Transfers to appropriate nursing staff for calls involving cancer, symptom-based calls, or as per caller request.
* Handles inbound calls for international patients; gathers all required documentation and sends the call content to a follow-up queue for the Penn Global Medicine team.
* Supports the Transfer of Care program.
* Helps facilitate follow-up appointments while the patient is still in the Penn Medicine hospital.
* Receives notification via software from a Penn Medicine provider with patient’s information.
* Contacts patient by phone while they are in the hospital.
* Works closely with requesting Penn Medicine provider to ensure efficiency of appointments.
* Handles physician-to-physician (Physician Link) calls; receives calls from outside Penn Medicine providers seeking to consult with Penn Medicine providers.
* Obtains (calling) physician’s information along with the new or mutual patient’s information and attempts to connect to the Penn Medicine provider via cell phone, text message, or office number.
* (If physicians are connected, the call is complete; if they are not able to connect, the inquiry gets sent to a Referral Nurse follow-up queue for completion.)
* Makes timely outbound calls in response to web, digital marketing campaigns, and other inquiries.
* Responds to online requests from Healthcare professionals and patients to schedule an appointment or access Penn Medicine services.
* Receives a Web Request Form from Healthcare professionals and patients (sent to a Salesforce queue in the MCC and distributed to staff for completion).
* Makes timely outbound call in response to the web request, using documented MCC guidelines.
* Utilizes the Avaya phone application to facilitate communication, including transfers to nurses, schedulers, crossfunctional departments, etc.
* Records all appropriate information in Salesforce concisely and accurately.
* Follows strict medical and legal aspects when offering referrals and performing outbound calls; protects patient confidentiality (HIPAA) at all times.
* Completes call processing efficiently; remains aware of call volumes; works as part of the team to handle the call.
* Supports the onboarding of new-hires; serves as side-by-side instructional guide; supports co-workers collegially.
* Meets Contact Center departmental productivity and process improvement objectives; assists in meeting or exceeding patient satisfaction and operational targets.
* Notifies Marketing Contact Center Manager of administrative or clinical issues and work-related problems.
* Recommends improvement to work processes, software systems, Customer Service, etc., as relevant and appropriate.
* Works as scheduled; demonstrates regular, consistent, and punctual attendance.
* Follows MCC policy requirements for time-off requests.
* Attends and participates in regularly scheduled operational meetings; reviews all minutes.

CUSTOMER SERVICE/HUMAN QUALITIES

* Assists the Marketing Contact Center in maintaining a strong patient/customer focus.
* Supports the delivery of high quality service and shares a passion for patient- and customer-centered care.
* Follows Penn Medicine Customer Service guidelines with all callers.
* Displays human qualities related to empathy, compassion, kindness, and patience.
* Accepts and follows through with constructive feedback, including results of QA monitoring and coaching sessions.
* Discusses work-related issues directly with management; avoids gossiping with co-workers.
* Collaborates willingly with management and co-workers; maintains a positive and optimistic outlook.
* Communicates sensitively with patients having possible hearing difficulties or memory/information processing difficulties.
* Arranges translation services for non-English speaking callers or asks to have an English speaking person confirm needs.

INNOVATION AND PROBLEM SOLVING

* Proactively surveys the environment to determine underlying or hidden problems that may result in potential
* hazards/issues for patients/customers and co-workers.
* Looks beyond the obvious when generating solutions and doesn’t stop at the first answer.
* Approaches problems from an organizational perspective; assesses implications of solutions to UPHS.
* Makes good and timely decisions based on a mixture of analysis, wisdom, experience, and judgment.

COMMUNICATION

* Displays effective professional writing skills.
* Completes forms comprehensively, clearly, and accurately.
* Prepares concise, accurate, and well-organized documentation of encounters, letters, and memos.
* Relays information via the appropriate method (e.g., letter, memo, fax, email).
* Speaks in a professional manner with callers and Penn Medicine co-workers.
* Manages telephone interactions by using appropriate titles and scripts (as appropriate) and by responding to the caller in a prompt, courteous, and informative manner.
* Exchanges clear/concise/accurate information via the most appropriate medium (e.g., face-to-face,
* phone/voicemail).
* Presents ideas and information in ways that others can easily understand.
* Conducts phone interactions using appropriate questioning, listening, clarifying, paraphrasing, and summarizing techniques to obtain accurate information from patients, customers, and staff.

NON-PATIENT CARE

#### **SUMMARY:**

The Director of Administration, in collaboration with the Department Chair and Rowan Medicine Administration (RMA), provides organizational leadership and operational oversight for the department. Reporting directly to the Department Chair, this role manages key operational, financial, compliance, human resources, and administrative functions that support the department's clinical, educational, and research missions.

The Director of Administration supervises administrative personnel, ensures effective communication and collaboration across stakeholders, and develops systems and processes that support departmental goals. This position serves as a liaison between the department and university, Rowan Medicine, and external partners, while promoting operational excellence, regulatory compliance, financial stewardship, and strategic growth. Depending on departmental structure and needs, the Director may oversee clinical, educational, research, and business operations.

#### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Other duties may be assigned in response to emerging and changing departmental needs.

#### **Clinical Operations**

* Provides leadership and oversight of departmental clinical operations to ensure efficient, high-quality service delivery and achievement of organizational goals.
* Develops, standardizes, and monitors operational processes, workflows, and performance metrics; identifies opportunities for improvement and implements corrective actions as needed.
* Collaborates with clinical and administrative leadership to optimize patient access, scheduling, referral management, provider productivity, and overall practice performance.
* Oversees the integrity and effectiveness of clinical information systems, electronic medical records, billing systems, and related operational technologies, partnering with appropriate stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Leads quality improvement initiatives and supports departmental compliance with regulatory, accreditation, and organizational standards.
* Collaborates with departmental leadership and external partners to support clinical network development, care coordination, and practice growth initiatives.

#### **Financial Management**

* Participates in the development, implementation, monitoring, and management of departmental budgets in collaboration with department leadership and institutional finance teams.
* Monitors financial performance, identifies variances, and recommends corrective actions to support fiscal responsibility and long-term sustainability.
* Oversees the administration and stewardship of departmental funding sources, including clinical revenue, academic budgets, grants, contracts, and discretionary funds, as applicable.
* Serves as a liaison with finance, accounting, compliance, legal, and other centralized administrative offices regarding departmental financial matters.
* Develops and analyzes financial reports, forecasts, and business plans to support strategic planning and operational decision-making.

#### **Strategic Planning and Business Development**

* Collaborates with departmental leadership to develop and implement strategic initiatives that advance the department's clinical, educational, and research missions while monitoring industry trends, regulatory changes, and market conditions that may impact departmental objectives.
* Identifies opportunities for growth, operational enhancement, program development, and service expansion.
* Assists in the development, negotiation, implementation, renewal, and management of contracts, affiliations, and service agreements in partnership with institutional stakeholders.
* Participates in business planning, feasibility assessments, and implementation of new initiatives and services.

#### **Human Resources Management**

* Supports departmental leadership in faculty and staff recruitment, hiring, onboarding, retention, and succession planning activities.
* Supervises administrative staff and may oversee managers and coordinators responsible for departmental operations.
* Develops position descriptions, conducts performance evaluations, and recommends personnel actions consistent with institutional policies.
* Coordinates credentialing, licensure, certifications, malpractice coverage, and clinical privileges, as applicable.
* Oversees workforce planning, scheduling, timekeeping, and staffing models to support departmental needs and operational efficiency.
* Fosters a positive, collaborative, and accountable work environment aligned with institutional values while supporting employee development and professional growth.

#### **Compliance, Policies, and Department Administration**

* Ensures departmental compliance with applicable federal, state, accreditation, healthcare, and university regulations, policies, and standards.
* Develops, implements, reviews, and monitors departmental policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Represents the department on institutional committees, task forces, and project teams as assigned.
* Coordinates departmental planning activities, communications, reporting requirements, and administrative operations.
* Supports faculty development, staff education, onboarding, and ongoing training initiatives.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

#### **EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Public Administration, or a related field required.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare administration, clinical operations, academic medicine, higher education, or a related healthcare environment.
* Equivalent combinations of education and directly related experience may be considered.
* Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Healthcare Administration (MHA), Public Administration (MPA), or related field preferred.
* Experience supporting clinical operations, physician practices, academic departments, or healthcare service lines preferred.
* Familiarity with healthcare operations, budgeting, compliance requirements, electronic medical records, revenue cycle processes, and performance improvement methodologies preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership, organizational, analytical, project management, and communication skills required.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams and effectively manage multiple priorities in a complex environment.

**SALARY INFORMATION**

In compliance with The State of New Jersey's Pay Transparency Act, the annual base salary range for this position is $130,000 to $135,000.00, with placement within the range determined by candidate's qualifications, professional experience, internal equity, and other factors.

45b75524efac6e2c36e1.description:
**Project Coordinator I: Project Management & Client Support – (CA, AZ, & MA)**

**About iQ Biosciences**

iQ Biosciences (iQ) is a specialized preclinical research partner dedicated to helping drug developers ask the right questions early to generate meaningful data and make confident decisions throughout development. Since 2014, our immunology expertise, coupled with our agility, drive, and collaborative approach, has made us the partner of choice for research organizations of all sizes and across a range of therapeutic areas. iQ offers an integrated, scientist-led model that combines three core capabilities – high-quality cellular products, in vitro bioservices, and custom bioconjugation – and a commitment to being as passionate about its clients' research as they are.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, the Project Coordinator I supports the successful delivery of scientific projects and contributes to inside-sales activities. This entry-level role will work closely with the Senior Project Manager and cross-functional scientific and operational teams to keep projects organized, communications timely, and client records current.

The position is designed for someone who is organized, client-focused, and wants to build a career in biotechnology project management, client services, or inside sales. Responsibilities may shift based on business needs and the employee’s strengths, interests, and demonstrated capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive project planning, execution, tracking, and closeout under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager.
* Track timelines, milestones, client materials, deliverables, action items, and follow-up needs. Surface any process gaps and identify corrective workflow processes.
* Coordinate with scientific, operational, business development, and finance teams to support timely project execution.
* Draft professional client communications and prepare proposals, project documents, and other client-facing materials.
* Coordinate internal and client meetings, including scheduling, agendas, decisions, and action items. Summarize key information in after action-reports and confirm understanding across stakeholders, utilizing background knowledge of scientific needs.
* Own invoicing, documentation review, deliverable tracking, and project closeout.
* Maintain accurate project, client, lead, and opportunity information in CRM and project-tracking systems.
* Follow up on inquiries and proposals, help qualify opportunities, and support existing client relationships.
* Develop project management training materials, tools, processes, and SOPs.
* Have ownership of projects as experience and proficiency grow.
* Provide additional project management, client service, inside sales, or administrative support based on business needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in biology, immunology, or a closely related life-science field.
* Interest in progressing in project management, client account support, or inside sales role.
* At least 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing role. Relevant experience may come from biotechnology, a contract research organization, hospitality, restaurants, or another service-oriented environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Confidence interacting with clients and internal stakeholders in a professional and service-oriented manner.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Who You Are**

* **Eager to learn:** You are curious, receptive to feedback, and motivated to continually build your scientific and project management knowledge.
* **Passionate about the science:** You enjoy understanding the scientific rationale behind each project and how the work supports the client’s broader goals.
* **Accountable:** You take ownership of your responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and communicate early when something may affect scope, timing, or deliverables.
* **Proactive:** You anticipate next steps, identify potential risks or gaps, and take action before they become larger issues.
* **Organized:** You can manage multiple projects, priorities, timelines, and follow-up items while maintaining attention to detail.
* **Detail-oriented:** You consistently produce accurate, thorough work and carefully review project details, pricing, documentation, and communications before they are finalized.
* **Collaborative:** You work effectively with scientific, operational, business development, and finance teams to keep projects moving.
* **Clear communicator:** You communicate thoughtfully and professionally, adapting the level of detail for clients and internal teams.
* **Adaptable:** You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where project needs, timelines, and priorities may change.

**General Information**

* Full-time, exempt position.
* Candidates **may be based in California, Arizona, or Massachusetts only.** On-site/hybrid in Alameda, CA preferred. Remote work from California, Arizona, or Massachusetts will be considered.
* Relocation assistance: No
* Occasional travel of 10%-15% may be required for conferences, client meetings, or company activities.
* Schedule: Based on location. Must be able to overlap hours to PST operating hours. Occasional night or weekend work may be required.
* Compensation: Range $60,000 to $83,000 annually, based on location/experience.
* Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with employer match after the introductory period, paid holidays, PTO, EAP, life and long-term disability insurance, FSA with employer contribution, and company-provided lunch/snacks.

This job description outlines the position's primary duties and requirements. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to support the goals and objectives of the organization.

e085bdcbac46f7b17a20.title: Affiliate and Partnerships Coordinator
e085bdcbac46f7b17a20.description:
**Who Are We?**

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 160 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

**Our Impact**

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,500 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don’t just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

**Our Vision**

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

**Are You Ready?**

This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.

**Check us out here:** **Decentralized Masters**  
  
**The Role**  
Decentralized Masters is looking for an Affiliate & Partnerships Coordinator to own the day-to-day operations of our affiliate and partnership program. The program spans affiliate networks, newsletter and media placements, and creator partnerships. This is an execution-focused role. You'll set up tracking, keep partner placements and copy current, run compliance checks, and produce the weekly reporting that keeps the program accountable.

You don't need to be an elite affiliate strategist to do this well. The focus is execution and consistency: taking over the operational workflow and keeping it running cleanly. You'll work closely with the Head of Partnerships, who owns strategy and partner relationships. Your job is to make the machine run.  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Link & tracking setup: Create and manage affiliate tracking links and offers in Everflow. Make sure attribution is configured correctly and firing end to end.
* Partner copy & updates: Manage and update creative and copy for partner placements. Keep offers, links, and assets current across all partners.
* Creator & media partnerships: Help source and coordinate placements with newsletters, YouTube and podcast channels, and other media and creator partners. Brief them on messaging and compliance, hand over tracking links and creative, schedule go-lives, and chase deliverables so campaigns launch on time.
* Compliance checks: Review partner copy and placements against our compliance guardrails before anything goes live. This is a regulated space, so accuracy and defensibility matter.
* Reporting: Produce detailed weekly performance reports across partners and affiliates. Surface what's working, what isn't, and where attribution is breaking.
* Analysis: Read performance data (spend, ROAS, CPA, conversion) and flag issues, opportunities, and anomalies.

  
**Requirements**

**What will you bring?**

* + - Hands-on experience running partnerships. Affiliate or partner tracking (Everflow or comparable) is ideal, but strong influencer, creator, or media and newsletter partnership experience counts too.
    - Strong analytical skills, with real comfort working across performance and attribution data.
    - High attention to detail, especially around compliance and reporting.
    - Solid written communication and the ability to manage and edit partner copy.
    - Organized and reliable, able to own a recurring workflow without hand-holding.

**Nice to have**

* + - Experience managing influencer, creator, YouTube, or podcast partnerships.
    - Business development or appointment-setting experience. Helpful but not required, since this can be shared with the wider team.
    - Familiarity with HubSpot, Hyros, or Snowflake.
    - Background in financial publishing, crypto, DeFi, or another regulated performance-marketing space.

  
**Benefits**

**What do we offer you?**

* + Competitive salary package
  + Full time/40 hours a week
  + Unlimited PTO
  + Flexible work schedule
  + Team off-sites
  + Young & dynamic culture with team members across 30+ countries
  + Fully Remote with a very supportive team. You have the ability to work from anywhere in the world!

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

fc1c07a228e4854f2e8e.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:** The full-time Medical Department Credentialing Coordinator serves and advocates for clinicians and provides administrative support to the Medical and Quality Assurance Departments. He/she serves as Credentialing Manager for Esperanza, coordinates provider on and off-boarding and manages the department budget.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Credentialing**

* Guide clinicians (and other licensed professional staff including BHC, Dentists, Nurses, and Dieticians) through the credentialing, privileging, and re-credentialing processes.
* Internal Credentialing
  + Request, gather, and maintain on file all relevant documentation for internal and external provider/staff credentialing
  + Create, maintain, and update credentialing reports and spreadsheets.
* Governmental Licensing
  + Coach clinicians in how and when to apply for licenses.
  + Submit initial supervision agreements (PA’s) and prescriptive authority applications (CRNP’s) for midlevel practitioners with state medical and nursing boards. Take lead in keeping up to date with changing requirements.
  + Maintain on file collaborative agreements for CRNP’s.
  + Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new clinicians with Medicaid and Medicare.
* Insurance/External Privileging
  + Prepare and submit privileging applications for new clinicians with insurance companies.
  + Request and maintain hospital privileges for applicable clinicians.
  + Maintain a filing system that allows for timely retrieval of requested information.
  + Keep a constant flow of communication between the insurance companies, hospitals, malpractice companies and medical billing agencies, to ensure EHC is in compliance with all state, city and federal regulations.
  + Research and resolve any and all credentialing issues.
  + Update and inform Medical Director, Dental Director, Behavioral Health Director, HR Director, Executive Director, and Billing Manager of any issues, changes in policies and/or provider status changes that may arise unexpectedly.
  + Keep a professional and friendly relationship with all network representatives.
* Re-credentialing
  + Manage the internal re-privileging process for clinicians and other licensed professional staff every two years (concurrent with the renewal date of providers’ licenses).
  + Create and maintain Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) profiles for billable practitioners in coordination with the Dental and BHC departments.
* Support clinician completion of continuing medical education requirements and reimbursements within Esperanza guidelines.

**Medical Director and Clinician Leadership Support**

* Support projects of Medical Director, Site Medical Directors and Associate Medical Directors as needed and as available.
* Know and communicate Medical Department policy to clinicians and staff when appropriate. Assist with drafting, editing, compiling, and formatting medical department policy and procedure.

**Clinician Support**

* Provide spiritual support, encouragement to clinician staff as needed
* Take initiative to check in with clinicians (especially at K&A), advocate for clinician wellbeing and concerns, and work toward resolution of any problems that arise.
* Respond to clinician communication in a timely fashion.
* Coordinate ACLS and BLS training for medical clinicians every 2 years.

**Human Resources**

* Participate in clinician screening and interviewing.
* Occasionally assist with clinician recruiting at conferences, career fairs, and other events.
* Communicate in a timely fashion with HR about clinician start dates, FMLA’s, leaves, and FTE changes.
* Coordinate and plan staff retreats with HR, as needed.
* Coordinate onboarding for oncoming clinicians, communicating with HR, IT and appropriate departments
* Coordinate exit process for departing clinicians including sending farewell letters to patients, scheduling a goodbye dinner, communicating with HR and appropriate departments, and overseeing patient reassignment in collaboration with Medical Department Administrator.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Help to cover tasks during absences of Medical Department Administrator.
* Coordinate tracking and maintenance of Athena Billable license count, working with IT and Finance to ensure that appropriate number of licenses are maintained
* Coordinate access to external EMR systems

**Budget Management**

* Manage departmental budget, track expenses, and ensure timely reimbursements.
* Prepare monthly credit card usage report.
* Project department expenses for annual budget proposal.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Demonstrates Godly character and lifestyle in keeping with authority of the Bible
* Self-directed and motivated.

* Exceptional organizational and interpersonal skills, with attention to detail required.

* Independent thinker and good problem-solver.
* Strong oral/written communication is required. Establishes and maintains open lines of communications with other staff.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team and manage multiple priorities, utilize effective time management skills, and exercise sound administrative judgment.
* Ability to analyze systems and to develop creative solutions to problems.
* Demonstrated ability to work well with people of various ages, backgrounds, ethnicities, and life experiences.
* Mature, well-spoken. Maintains discretion and confidentiality in communicating with others.
* Wisdom and courage to evaluate candidates in a way that preserves Esperanza’s mission and honors and respects those who may not be good fits.
* Communicates the love of Christ through interactions, not complaining or arguing, but expressing hope in Christ and His promises.
* Seeks to serve Christ and proclaim the gospel in word and deed.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* NAMSS certification preferred.
* At least 1-2 years of administrative experience preferred.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
* Experienced with MS Word and Excel.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Must be able to work in regular office environment.

03eed54841f63bb36468.title: Service Operations Coordinator
03eed54841f63bb36468.description:
**Service Operations Coordinator - Scheduling, Dispatch & Administration**

**Oley, PA/Full Time**

Mast Roofing & Construction in Oley, PA is seeking a full-time Service Operations Coordinator to keep our phones, appointment schedules, dispatch activities, and service administration running accurately and efficiently. This is a Client Care Representative position with substantial responsibility for coordinating the work behind every client interaction and helping turn incoming opportunities into completed, profitable work.

Answering a high volume of incoming calls is a central part of this role. Success also requires active thinking, independent judgment, and timely decisions. You will move between live calls, scheduling changes, technician needs, payments, and detailed administrative work throughout the day. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, anticipates problems, and follows through without waiting for repeated direction.

Annual earning potential is $45,000–$65,000, with a starting base of $22/hour+, DOE (depending on experience), plus performance incentives and bonus opportunities. Benefits include personalized training, paid holidays including your birthday, paid time off (PTO), medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, and an IRA retirement plan with a 100% company match up to 3%.

Are you quick-thinking, highly organized, and accurate under pressure? Can you listen closely, ask the right questions, and enter information directly into a computer system while keeping a conversation moving? If you enjoy solving scheduling problems, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership of results, we would like to meet you.

**ABOUT MAST ROOFING & CONSTRUCTION**

We are a faith-based, family-run, full-service residential and light commercial roofing and construction company. For over 28 years, we have built our reputation by caring for our clients and delivering quality workmanship through expert training, technology, and industry experience.

Our mission is simple: To honor God by serving those around us with excellence. Our Core Values — W.I.S.E. — guide how we work: Work Hard, With Integrity, Serving Others, and With Excellence. We value our employees and their families and encourage personal growth, skill development, and a positive, professional culture of ownership and accountability.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

You help set the pace for the day. You answer calls, identify client needs, book appointments, and keep the CRM current as conversations happen. You coordinate with sales and production, adjust schedules as priorities change, and help technicians arrive prepared. Between calls, you prepare production folders, process payments, track appointment outcomes, and make sure the next person has the information needed to do the job well.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

Handle a high volume of incoming calls with professionalism, urgency, and accuracy. Work toward answering 98% of calls by the third ring and use a headset throughout the work shift to support efficient call handling.

Maintain a minimum 80% booking ratio by using approved scripts, asking effective questions, explaining the value of our services, and addressing objections confidently and respectfully.

Listen and type client information directly into the CRM during live conversations, without relying on handwritten notes for later entry. Capture contact details, service needs, commitments, and next steps completely and accurately.

Respond to online quote requests within 5 minutes of submission, return client calls within 5 minutes, and respond to emails, texts, and calls daily in accordance with company procedures.

Schedule repair and replacement appointments, service calls, estimates, and final 25 Point roof inspections. Confirm appointment details, start dates, times, and any changes promptly with clients and the appropriate staff.

Coordinate and dispatch repair inspections and production calls under the direction of the Production Manager. Make proactive scheduling decisions within established guidelines to support profitable dispatching, productive technician time, efficient travel, and timely client service.

Monitor the schedule for gaps, conflicts, delays, and changing priorities. Take action to keep appointments moving, communicate adjustments, and escalate decisions that exceed your authority.

Generate sales orders in the CRM, record and verify appointment results, and follow up with the responsible staff when results or supporting details are missing. Keep administrative tracking systems updated daily.

Prepare complete, accurate production and job folders, including jobs with signed proposals and deposits awaiting contracts. Ensure repair and replacement paperwork reaches the appropriate staff before appointments.

Route required job pouches to management for commission entry and review. Transfer completed job folders to the Office Manager for invoicing and send contracts for electronic signatures as directed.

Collect required payments and payment information on booked and confirmed calls, following company procedures for authorization, accurate processing, documentation, and protection of client information.

Assist clients who choose financing and complete vendor warranty registrations after final invoicing. Track outstanding documents and follow through until required administrative steps are complete.

Provide prompt support to technicians and sales representatives. Maintain clear communication so that client commitments, appointment requirements, and job information are understood across the team.

Follow up daily with clients who have requested communication. Resolve service concerns promptly, respectfully, and with empathy; provide daily updates to the Sales Manager on escalated interactions and support a quality or recommendation score of at least 9/10 through PulseM or an equivalent system.

Report directly to the Sales Manager, meet weekly to review goals and results, and attend meetings and required training prepared and on time. Participate in phone skills training at least twice yearly and help improve scripts and processes.

Maintain organized records and work areas, meet reporting deadlines, and promptly notify management of serious accidents, damage, liability or warranty concerns, fraud, theft, or serious Core Value breaches.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

Prior experience in service coordination, dispatch, appointment scheduling, client care, or administrative operations. Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, or another trade service business is strongly preferred.

Comfort managing a high volume of phone calls while completing time-sensitive scheduling, dispatch, and administrative responsibilities.

Fast, accurate keyboarding and the ability to listen, ask questions, and type directly into a CRM during a live conversation without first taking handwritten notes. Strong typing speed must be matched by accuracy and complete records.

Sound judgment and confidence making timely decisions within established procedures, with the ability to recognize when management input is needed.

Proven ability to work independently, take initiative, anticipate needs, and follow responsibilities through to completion without repeated reminders.

Strong attention to detail and a commitment to checking names, addresses, appointment times, payments, and job documentation for accuracy.

Ability to shift quickly between tasks, manage interruptions, and maintain a productive pace in a busy environment with changing priorities and firm deadlines.

Practical, analytical problem-solving skills and an understanding of how booking, scheduling, dispatch, and follow-up affect productivity, revenue, and profitability.

Clear verbal and written communication, professional phone skills, and the ability to explain service options and respond to objections while treating clients respectfully.

Confidence using CRM systems, scheduling tools, email, spreadsheets, and multiple computer applications, with the ability to learn new systems and follow established workflows.

Integrity, discretion with confidential information, dependable attendance, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to accept coaching and improve performance.

**SERVICE AREAS**

This is a full-time onsite position at our company offices in Oley, PA, supporting clients and field operations throughout Berks County and surrounding areas, including Reading and Allentown, PA.

**ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM**

Do you enjoy taking ownership of a busy schedule, solving practical problems, and keeping details accurate while the phones are ringing? Are you ready to combine excellent client care with the initiative and judgment that help a service business succeed? If our mission, Core Values, and expectations resonate with you, complete our quick, mobile-friendly application today. All applications are confidential. We look forward to meeting you!

**Mission:**

To Honor God by serving others around us with excellence

**Core Values: W.I.S.E.**

Core Values form the foundation of the company. Adhering to our Core Values will help us build a strong and healthy organization.

#1 Work Hard -We approach each task with diligence and a positive attitude.

#2 With Integrity – We are honest with our clients, each other, and ourselves.

#3 Serving others – We treat others as more important than ourselves.

#4 with Excellence – We execute at a high level, striving to exceed expectations.

f0f80cba9ce1f51a5544.description:
**Department:**

36808 GCMG: Wellness Hub - Medical Weight Management

**Status:**

Full time

**Benefits Eligible:**

Yes

**Hou****rs Per Week:**

40

**Schedule Details/Additional Information:**

M-F 8a-5p (lunch 12-1 daily)

**Pay Range:**

$22.90 - $34.35

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Adheres to Medical Assistant scope of practice, follows all policies and procedures, and maintains training and competency based on area of specialty when providing patient care.
* Performs rooming/visit tasks such as vital signs, medication reconciliation, medical history, health maintenance, allergy review, and screenings (depression, suicide, falls, social drivers of health, etc.).
* Assists provider with or performs procedures as ordered.
* Performs lab related duties such as venipuncture, specimen collection/labeling/packing, preparation of lab orders/requisitions, and results tracking. Point of Care testing (POCT) per standing order/provider order. Completes Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) approved waived laboratory tests and practice-specific diagnostic testing in adherence to CLIA standards.
* Administers medications and vaccines safely following the rights of medication administration.
* Performs other duties as assigned such as medication refills, insurance authorizations, safety/regulatory log completion, patient messaging, medication/supply ordering, appointment scheduling, and referrals.
* Demonstrates effective and timely communication, teamwork, and appropriate escalation.
* Maintains a clean work environment ensuring instruments and equipment are cleaned appropriately. Ensures equipment and supplies are in working order, and areas are appropriately stocked.
* May assist with training and onboarding of other teammates.
* May serve as a role champion or on a committee.
* Must be able to demonstrate knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served. Must demonstrate knowledge of the principles of growth and development over the life span and possess the ability to assess data reflective of the patient's status and interpret the appropriate information needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his/her age-specific needs, and to provide the care needed as described in the department's policies and procedures. Age-specific information is developed further in the departmental job standards.

**Minimum Job Requirements**

**Education**

Greater Charlotte:

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant program or may have completed structured military training which is clinical in nature per DD214 in lieu of a formal medical assistant program or EMT.

IL/WI Divisions:

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Completion of an accredited or approved program in Medical Assistant, or 2 years of verifiable full-time experience as a Medical Assistant within the last 5 years.

Wake Forest:

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant program or may have completed structured military training which is clinical in nature per DD214 in lieu of a formal medical assistant program or EMT.

Floyd & Navicent:

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Completion of an accredited or approved program in Medical Assistant, or 2 years of verifiable full-time experience as a Medical Assistant within the last 5 years.

**Certification / License**

Greater Charlotte:

* Current American Heart Association (AHA) BLS certification required.
* Successful completion of Atrium Health’s competency assessment.

* Recognized or certified as a CMA or RMA by one of the following National Organizations: American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA), National Health Career Association (NHA), National Healthcare Worker's Association (NHCWA), National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT), American Registry of Medical Assistants (ARMA) American Medical Technologists (AMT), National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP), National Registry of Medical Assistants (NRMA).
* Successful completion of system approved program to become a primary trainer for new teammates.

IL/WI Divisions:

* Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers certification issued by the American Heart Association (AHA) needs to be obtained within 45 days unless department leader has determined it is not required.
* Certified or registered as a CMA or RMA by one of the following National Organizations: American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA), Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) certification issued by the National Health Career Association (NHA), RMA certification issued by the American Medical Technologists (AMT), Medical Assistant (NCMA) certification issued by the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT), Clinical Medical Assistant Certification (CMAC), or American Medical Certification Association (AMCA).

Wake Forest:

* Current American Heart Association (AHA) BLS certification required
* American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA), American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Allied Health (AAH), National Healthcare Worker's Association (NHCWA), National Health Career Association (NHA), (MCMA), National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP), National Registry of Medical Assistants (NRMA),
* Pediatric Emergency Assessment, Recognition, and Stabilization (PEARS) may be required within 1 year in select areas.

* Successful completion of Atrium Health’s competency assessment.
* Demonstrates professional practice advancement through professional governance, safety coach, super-user, vaccine coordinator, SPICE or OSHA/IP certificate holder for unit
* Achieves 6 points from the list of additional market responsibilities

Floyd & Navicent:

* Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers certification issued by the American Heart Association (AHA) needs to be obtained within 45 days unless department leader has determined it is not required.
* Certified or registered as a CMA or RMA by one of the following National Organizations: American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA), Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) certification issued by the National Health Career Association (NHA), RMA certification issued by the American Medical Technologists (AMT), Medical Assistant (NCMA) certification issued by the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT), Clinical Medical Assistant Certification (CMAC), or American Medical Certification Association (AMCA).

**Experience**

* Two years of experience in a clinical practice setting as a Medical Assistant.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Ability to perform routine and complex technical skills, within the Medical Assistant scope of practice after demonstrated competency.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to develop rapport and maintain positive, professional relationships with a variety of patients, team members and physicians.
* Proficient computer skills including keyboarding, navigation within a windows operating system, and use of electronic mail with exposure to electronic medical records systems.
* Demonstrates customer service skills that support a positive patient experience.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

* Must sit, stand, walk, lift, squat, bend, twist, crawl, kneel, climb, and reach above shoulders throughout the workday.
* Ability to lift 35 pounds without assistance. For patient lifts over 35 pounds, or when patient is unable to assist with lift, patient handling equipment is expected to be used, with at least one other team member, when available.
* Unique patient lifting/movement situations will be assessed on a case- by -case basis.
* Must have functional speech, vision, hearing, and touch with ability to use fine-hand manipulation skills.
* Will be exposed to the following hazards on a frequent basis: mechanical, electrical, chemical, blood and body fluids. Will be required to wear protective clothing and equipment as needed.
* Operates all equipment necessary to perform the job.

*This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the incumbent. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be required to perform other related duties.*

**Our Commitment to You:**

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

**Compensation**

* Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training
* Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job
* Incentive pay for select positions
* Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

**Benefits and more**

* Paid Time Off programs
* Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses
* Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave
* Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs
* Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

**About Advocate Health**

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

Apply increased knowledge and experience to support the care team by performing clinical and administrative tasks that are vital to patient care. Medical Assistant IIs must adhere to all relevant regulations and guidelines to ensure patient safety and confidentiality. They are expected to maintain a high level of professionalism and compassion during all interactions.
